Again the amount was put back into my Southwest account until it expired and now they’re are offering me a small voucher after all my flight money has been taken. I am so disgusted by the way they handled the refunds during the pandemic. I vow to never board Southwest ever again!

header: We were 2 minutes past their cutoff
content: We arrived at 7:52 for an 8:00 flight and got rejected at the gate. Apparently, Southwest has a very strict policy of cutting off boarding 10 minutes before takeoff. We were 2 minutes past their cutoff but they had no mercy during the holiday season. I other airline I have flown will cut you off; if you make it before take off you are good. On top of that, the gate attendant was unkind and cold. I will never fly southwest again and I don’t recommend them to anyone. Silly policies and poor customer service.

The stewards were so rude. We selected to sit by the door for leg room. They asked to respond verbally and my husband responded Si. She yelled at him saying in English! Really! Glared at us whole time. Seats were separated and when we asked is there a way we can sit together we were told to appreciate what we had. On the way back everyone seems grouchy or in a bad mood. Maybe they are over worked because so many lost jobs over vaccine mandates. But for whatever the reason I will never fly with Southwest again. Did not appreciate the treatment on a six hour flight going both ways.

Spoke with a reservation agent regarding booking a military flight for four round trip tickets on Dec 12 for Dec 24.-Jan 3.. Was told that paris would not need a seat so we proceeded to talk about purchasing three seats and were asked for our card details so it can be placed on file. After giving our details the gentleman made the purchase without any consent of the purchase being made at that moment or anything. My husband had to look at our account to see that money had been taken after asking the gentleman why would he not notify us he then proceeds to say that he never really took our son into account(put him in the system) and now he need to make a separate purchase because he infants does need a seat and that any 2 and up has to pay for a seat, although in a previous conversation he had said 2 and under. Not once did he apologize for charging our card without approval nor for neglecting to tell us our child did need a seat at the time of purchase when being told originally that he didn’t. We are in the holiday season when tickets can be pricey and I feel that we should’ve been given a option as to which airline would accommodate us better instead our money was taken and now we have to week 7-10 business days to get the money back and by then all the airline seats will be sold out or higher due to this inconvenience. I asked to speak with a supervisor and was switched to a department without briefing them of my case and without any notations being place on my account. And the Supervisor didn’t help either it was either get a refund or pay full price for my sons ticket(a seat that he will not sit in) no discount, no taxes dropped for making me have to do two purchases when being asked if 4 tickets needed to be purchased and/or no comped seat for the child. Completely unprofessional experience and I never intend to fly with this company again. There’s no respect for the customers and they don’t believe in satisfying the customers even when the customers are looking for a resolve.

I was flying from Houston to Florida and had a lay over in New Orleans. Lay over originally was 50mins but then flight got delayed. I land in Tampa and apparently me and several people who had similar lay overs all had luggage left back in New Orleans. The airline couldn't have bothered to transfer our bags on time?  There was ample time and they ruined a weekend trip i planned. Southwest, you need to get your act together and have better policies. Now we are all waiting to get our stuff back. I  will never travel Southwest again. This is just pure laziness and could have been avoided. Thanks for the $200 travel voucher.
I have been delayed 3 times on this flight. I was suppose to be in las Vegas at 4:45 pm. Not I’m barely about to board and it’s 6:20pm. This is terrible time management.

My husband and I recently flew Southwest Airlines coming home from a vacation trip. The Southwest Airlines steward, Lloyd, was so attentive and respectful. He offered walking and seat change assistance to an elderly woman on the plane. He also checked on all the passengers several times throughout the flight to make sure everyone was doing okay. Lloyd made the flight enjoyable and comfortable. I will definitely continue to fly with Southwest because of him.

header: the boarding passes were split up
content: Can’t believe the lack of EQ from Staff. Had to buy a last minute ticket for my 2 year old daughter and 5 year old son. Somehow the boarding passes were split up. So my son was A and me and my daughter were B. So we tried to board in the A group seeing as we would be called up in another 20 or so people. And the man taking tickets refused to let us do so. Very disgusted with his attitude, as he was treating us like shop lifters.

header: voucher expired by the end of 2020!
content: I flew with Southwest Airlines from San Francisco to LA! The flight had a delay of about 3 or 4 hours! The flight attendant gave all the passengers vouchers for about $100. The voucher expired by the end of 2020! The pandemic time! Everywhere was closed and some of the people didn’t feel safe to travel during that time! Now since everything is getting better I called the airline, I asked about extending my voucher, I explained everything, it was a pandemic for all the world not only California! They don’t do it! Why? Because they keep saying we have 6 months policy after the expiration date! It was a pandemic! Such a bad experience 4 hours delay (however this is not irregular for Southwest), no care about customers!

Booked fares to Stl from Hou. At midnight Oct 10, received a text saying flight was canceled and to log on to SW to rebook.....no flights available! Called CS and there was a recording stating there was a 120 minute wait. Got rental car to drive back to Hou. SW gives me a $150 voucher? Doesn’t cover even one fare, not to mention the car and fuel! Never again!

header: pleasantly surprised that I felt okay even though it was chaotic
content: My friend and I were trying to fly out of Los Angeles (Burbank) to NYC and of course the fog was crazy this particular morning. Burbank ended up canceling every flight (at least in the morning). The lady at one of the kiosks was super helpful. In a very stressful situation (for everyone) was cool, calm, and collected. She was kind and quick when helping us out. I was pleasantly surprised that I felt okay even though it was chaotic.

header: I doubt I will fly Southwest again
content: We flew Southwest for family vacation to Cancun. We went from GR to Chicago and when boarding started they said first come first serve on seats and we were letter C so we're last to board. Some of us got to sit together to Chicago, once we boarded in Chicago to Cancun again first come first serve we were letter C again . My family was strong put through out the whole airplane . My son has a brain injury and didn't have a clue how to fill out the declaration papers. So you people need to start assigning seats. We all ended up in middle seats and were like sardines  .. for the money we paid should of got better service. No one wants to move or offer a seat because they want an empty seat between them. With my experience I doubt I will fly Southwest again.

header: our first time ever flying Southwest and it will be our last
content: This was our first time ever flying Southwest and it will be our last. Totally disorganized and for the price of our ticket it was a rip-off. We paid $1200 each plus upgraded once not realizing that people can sit in the same area without paying. This was from Nashville to Puerto Vallarta. I have traveled all over the world including on many foreign carriers and have never had an experience even close to this one. Beware!

Southwest has been getting progressively worse. If I had a problem with one flight once in a while it would be fine, but every time I fly Southwest something happens. They damaged my brand new suitcase. 4 hr delay. 30 minute delay because their attendant was late. A very unprofessional airline. Many of the employees are pretty grumpy. Wouldn't recommend

I had the most terrible experience flying with Southwest for the first time. First, I had to deal with security at Baltimore airport, who shook me down over a bottle of hair cream and because of the sparkles on my sweater and missed my first flight, then I was placed on a later flight with Southwest, waiting to get back home to Florida, but waited an entire hour at the airport, due to the flight being delayed and the Southwest staff failing to update us on why we were an hour late leaving the airport. When an explanation was finally provided, we were told that our plane had to be towed, which made no sense, then we were told that we were unable to board, due to a technical issue with the computers. So, we were dealing with a huge, tired and confused group of people, waiting around in the airport, just waiting to go home. Oh and the saga doesn't end there, once we were FINALLY able to board the plane, we had to wait an additional 30 minutes, for no reason. I don't think I will ever fly with Southwest again, I didn't get back to Florida until 10:30pm and still had to drive 45 minutes to where I actually live, from West Palm Beach.

Overall, my flight was great. We arrived just in time for boarding, and it was quick and fast. Taxing was surprisingly quick.  Entertainment was easy, you could bring your own handheld device. The website offered a ok selection of movies and tv shows, along with free messaging (iMessage and WhatsApp). Internet costs 8$, but free for A-List Preferred members I believe. Lastly, they had a good selection of Live TV stations and free Iheartradio. The seat width was good for a 2 hour flight, however one concern I would have is food. They only offer a snack mix on the airline, however they do offer a selection of beverages. If you are going on a longer flight, please bring your own food. The landing provided scenic views of the Hoover Dam, the touchdown was a little bumpy. I would recommend Southwest if you want a great experience and cheap fares. And I forgot to mention, be sure to take advantage of their free baggage system! (first 2 bags free)

Worst experience flying with Southwest. First they cancel your flight, then the process to rebook is a headache, also don’t forget after they rebook us from our original itinerary to San Diego I have to land at Ontario and have someone drive 4 hours (there and back) to pick me up. Also my luggage is on a completely different flight. Not only that but my other friend is given false tickets since she was left in Long Beach instead of lay over in Oakland and land in San Diego. She lands in Long Beach without luggage as well.

header: not recommend flying with them ever
content: SWA Canceled our flight to Vegas 3 hrs before take off (6:30am) via text 11/1/21. We were advised to jump online to re-book, by the time we did there were no flights available. We were meeting friends, pre-paid hotel, had Lionel Ritchie tickets and this was a vacation we had planned 10 months in advance. We never got to go because other airlines same day booking were astronomically high. We missed our concert, vacation and friends because of SWA employee no shows, this was the reason for cancellation. We complained to SWA and their response was a $150 voucher, after losing out over $1500 in hotel fees and concert tickets. Beware of this airline trying to make amends at faults of their own. Their customer relations dept are horrible and would not recommend flying with them ever.

header: No one knew what was going on
content: Absolutely the worst experience I’ve ever had at an airport/with an airline. We got to the airport at 1pm for a 4.35pm departure. We were moved to 3 different lines and eventually at 3.0pm we reached the ticket counter. When we reached the front of the line they then took people behind us that were on a flight that departed 10 minutes before ours. No one knew what was going on and the extra time we wanted to use to get food and other items was now gone and we had to rush to our gate.

header: We could not be happier with the care and help
content: Our flight from Albany to San Antonio on Southwest had us worried after the problems of cancelled flights a few weeks earlier. Also this was our first try at bringing a folding electric wheelchair for use at our destination as well as during the layovers. We could not be happier with the care and help with getting the chair aboard the plane and retrieving it at each destination. The personnel at the check in and the gates at Albany, Baltimore, and San Antonio, were superb. I would recommend Southwest to any traveler and especially passengers that need assistance. Southwest people are the best.
This has been the worst experience I've ever had with an airline, so many delays. Now I'm on a 2 hour delay from Dallas to Indianapolis and I won't get home until after midnight - unacceptable.

header: lousy way to end a family trip
content: Continuing saga. After a three plus hour delay at John Wayne Airport and a thirty-six minute flight we get to spend another three hour plus wait in the McCarran airport since the delay caused us to miss our flight to Reno. They assigned us to group C boarding yet we had paid the upgrade to A boarding. When questioned they just said they'll refund our money. A lousy way to end a family trip to Disneyland. With the delay to fly down and back we could have driven and saved the sore arse, back and frustration. JSX or AHA here we come.

I have never had such a terrible experience. Multiple delays, missed connections and rude staff. After paying for early boarding, we were bumped down to the C boarding group due to a three hour delay causing us to miss our connection. We phoned Southwest from the airport and they refused to help us. We even asked if we could pay more to be part of group A-15. Due to Southwest issues, I was not able to even sit with my husband. As they say at Southwest “C is for the center seat”. We will never fly Southwest again. We could have driven in half the time it took us to fly. This was not a budget flight paying $450 each for for the trip. Never again!

header: they fail to live up to any form of arriving or departing on time
content: I've flown this airline three times and each time there has been a delay of two to three hours each. Often for no reason of why. I've no problem with the crew but have grievous trepidations about the airline organization itself. They claim low cost which is true but they fail to live up to any form of arriving or departing on time. This will be an airline of last resort. Fly at your own risk especially if there is a connecting flight.

As I am writing the review now, when my flight is supposed to be already in air and should have been reaching Nashville in an hour. But, I am still sitting with full house flight still at LaGuardia since 6:55pm. And the pilot is waiting for the gas in the flight as we speak! This is very unprofessional. If someone actually have an emergency, I would not suggest Southwest Airlines to anyone.

header: won’t be flying with them again
content: I called customer service before my flight because I was nervous about traveling with my wedding dress. She assured me I could just ask for help from the flight attendants with my dress to make sure it doesn’t get squished in the overhead bin. When I boarded, I asked the flight attendant at the front for help and he laughed at me and told me there’s nothing they can do to help me, and then when I got by the seat I chose, I asked another flight attendant for help and she said the same thing. Horrible experience. They didn’t even act like they cared about getting my expensive wedding dress to my wedding safely. I’m very annoyed and won’t be flying with them again.

The lady announced for active duty service member to board along with handicap personnel and when I went to board the other lady stated that I cannot board as an active duty service member unless I'm in uniform. She stated "I already told you you cannot board active duty military if you are not in uniform". The Navy is not even allowed to travel I'm any uniform but dress uniform via commercial plane. She was very rude and disrespectful, she rolled her eyes and said under her breath something about "privileged".

header: the attendant was rude and dismissive
content: I fly domestically and internationally a great deal and use Southwest to get from Sacramento to LAX for international connections and to Orange County to visit family. One of the flight attendants from Sacramento to Burbank was rude and dismissive and actually embarrassed one traveler in front of the rest of us. At Burbank today on the flight back to Sacramento, I went to the counter to pay for a better seating position and the attendant was rude and dismissive. Is this a new policy on the part of Southwest? I have been flying for 65 years all over the world and most other airlines go out of their way to be kind, welcoming and make your journey the most positive experience possible. Why not Southwest?

header: the worst experience I have ever had flying
content: Absolutely the worst experience I have ever had flying! After about an hour on route they tell us there is an electrical issue with the plane so we turn back around! Sounds harmless yet already very much inconvenient! Afterwards they take an additional 3 hours to rebook us on another flight that took another 2 hours to get "gassed", then proceeded to tell me that if I miss my connecting flight it is my fault! I will never fly with Southwest again!

header: Southwest left us with no options and they didn’t care
content: Never have I ever been so poorly treated by Southwest Airlines. My husband and myself were supposed to leave Las Vegas headed back to Indianapolis on Monday Nov 1st at 6am. Instead we got a late email at 7pm October 30, informing us that are flight is cancelled and we won’t be able to fly out until the next day at 9.40 with a layover. Southwest refused to accommodate us with a hotel, food nor a different flight to a city close to Indianapolis. We had just found out we lost our grandmother and couldn’t get home. Instead they offered a 100 love flight voucher as if that would cover another night at the Aria or food and drinks for another full day stay. We had to miss an extra day of work and had to pay an extra day of child care because we had no other way of getting to our children. No way of getting to our family when they needed us the most. Southwest left us with no options and they didn’t care. The service coordinators were unhelpful, I’ve never been so poorly treated in my life. I’d never recommend anyone to fly them ever again. You all should be a ashamed of yourselves.

header: I used to gladly fly SWA - now it has become my last resort
content: SWA used to be a “cool”, fun airline. On time performance, top notch flight attendants, good planes. Whatever it is that has happened in the past year or so, the service is worse than UA and AA. The flight attendants are very surly. On time device is miserable and the planes are looking very tired. I used to gladly fly SWA - now it has become my last resort.

header: I'm going with American next flight
content: Flew into Denver from Dallas, headed to Reno. For the second time in a row the flight was changed to another gate. This time the flight was delayed due to awaiting another aircraft to arrive then waiting another half hour for baggage to arrive from another flight. I made it home one hour late due to SW taking care of 5 customers instead of the others on the full flight. Bye SW. I'm going with American next flight. Choosing dollars over customers is not my type of business to do business.

Southwest has been horrible. For work, I flew from Las Vegas to Dallas for a connecting flight and was suppose to fly to Tampa. The connecting flight got canceled due to "weather" which Southwest lied. I was stuck in Dallas airport for two days without any luggage. Southwest could not get me back to Tampa so I had to fly to Atlanta and rent a car for $569.00 to drive back to Tampa. In the process, my Macbook screen was shattered by Southwest and it was in my luggage. Southwest denied the claim because it was past the four hours and they do not do claims on "electronic equipment". I couldn't report the damage within four hours because my luggage made it to Tampa without me since Southwest could not get me home. On top of everything, my zipper was broken, lock cut off my suite case and laptop screen broken. Southwest maintained it was "weather related" even though no other airline canceled their flights. This trip with Southwest has caused many issues and I will make sure my organization will not use them again.

header: delivers when flying in and out of Reno
content: Reno-Los Angeles via San Jose, Los Angeles-Reno. As always Southwest is great flying out of Reno. On time and friendly service. Two of the three flights were on a 737-700 but one leg had the 737-800 max. I really liked the max. For the most part almost new, very clean and good leg space. The flights were pretty uneventful which is fine with me. Standard beverage service and bag of pretzels. The return flight out of Los Angeles was a half hour delayed due to weather so really can't complain about that. No beverage service on that flight as turbulence was predicted because of flying through a storm but it never really materialized. Had my own drink and snacks that I brought so no problem. All in all Southwest always delivers when flying in and out of Reno.

header: not recommend purchasing the early bird check-in
content: When Southwest Airlines first came out with the early bird special to purchase for early check-in, I thought it was a great idea. However, it sucks or is a scam. Seven times out of seven, I got in the worse boarding positions; only the very first time was I in "A" boarding category. My boarding positions were as follows (when I used the early bird check-in): A36, B15, B22, C1, B7, C10, B30. I will no longer purchase the early bird special. as it (clearly) does not check you in early for good boarding positions. Oh, as a side note, the last 3 check-ins I did without the early bird special, when I did it myself, my boarding positions were: A5, A8, A12. In case nobody knows, seat are not assigned, just boarding positions. So when they announce that they are boarding "A" passengers to board the plane, then A1-A36 passengers enter the plane first and get the pick of the seat, then B1-B36 and then C1-36. So you can imagine how bad the seats left over were, if you're in the "B" and especially the "C' categories. Don't buy the early bird special, it's not worth the extra money, especially when they cannot even guarantee that you'll be in the "A" category at all. I would recommend the airline because it's usually inexpensive, but I would not recommend purchasing the early bird check-in service, because it sucks, or is a scam for additional for nothing!

My entire plan was derailed because of airline staffing and delays. In the end I was instead flown to LAX and unable to secure transportation without spending 4xs what I had planned to because of the inconvenience. I believe it's fair to have the expectation that companies provide the service that you purchase on time. Safety issues I might understand but poor planning isn't acceptable. Use a different carrier ... bags fly free but you and your bags may to tardy for the party.

Worst experience on an airplane ever. I had been flying Southwest loyally for over 10 years. Today we had a flight from Hartford to Baltimore get delayed. In Baltimore I had a connecting flight to Sarasota. I asked the gate attendant if we would be in jeopardy of missing our connection to Sarasota. She said no that flight was also delayed. We arrived in the A wing , ran frantically to the B wing to make our connection. Myself and over 10 other passengers found the door to board closed, plane still there and we were denied access to the plane. Without our knowledge, Southwest changed our flights to a later flight without ever notified us all. They refused to let all of us on the plane that was still sitting there. I paid extra to be in the A group for priority boarding, but my reissued ticket has us in the C group, last people to board. When asked the attendant said it would cost an additional $40. I already paid the $40 on my original ticket and I know from past experience that whenever I changed my reservation I never lost my A status. Because Southwest made the changes, that did not happen. I will never fly them again. Thank you Southwest for sticking a loyal customer in the back of the plane. You denied us all access to our original flight, delayed our original flight, changed our reservation without our notice and stuck us in the back of the plane. Keep your travel voucher Southwest. You mistreated many customers today. I will try your new competitor Avelo which is actually cheaper or Jet Blue from now on. I am also going to cancel my Southwest credit card as you do not value my time and me as a customer.

I have now contacted Southwest 3 times with no satisfaction. Five members of my family were stranded in Chicago on their way to Florida due to canceled flights. After 3 days a family member drove to Chicago, 4 hours away to pick them up. Their luggage was returned 10 days later. The compensation for that was 1 $150 voucher. In a response to the canceled flights, the response was basically, it’s not our problem. They were out over $1000 in hotel and food bills plus the cost of loss time for someone to pick them up. Southwest sent a $150 voucher. I guess 5 people are supposed to split that. I am very disappointed with Southwest and their lack of consideration for the people who make this airplane profitable!

Terrible business model, if you reserve a flight six months in advance then cancel within a week you cannot get a refund, you are instead offered a credit which can be used to purchase another flight through Southwest Airlines, but only within the next 12 months. You are required to pay a higher price for a ticket to get a refund just in case you need to cancel the flight to actually get your money back.

header: nothing they can do for us
content: Due to Covid nonsense when we booked a flight in January 2020 we had to cancel. We are getting married Nov 19 2021 and wanted to use our credit to fly for our honeymoon leaving Nov 23rd 2021 and the customer service is so unfair, that she states it expires on Nov 15th and that we can do our honeymoon before the wedding! So basically there’s nothing they can do for us.

header: extremely weary of being treated like cattle
content: I have flown Southwest for several years but currently looking at other options. The service, dependability, and customer service of the past has dramatically changed and not for the better. I just returned yesterday on a flight from Texas. It is not possible as evidenced by passengers exiting the flight and the time at which passengers are then boarded for cleaning and sanitizing to be completed per their stated protocol. That, and the discarded wrappers in the seat pockets, as well as a sticky substance, splashed on the back of the seat in front of me further validates this. In addition, I have definitely had it with checking in at the very moment possible only to board and find passengers who've already boarded saving seats for others further back in the boarding process, while flight attendants who are very obviously aware do not enforce their own boarding practice. I am extremely weary of being treated like cattle. Most airlines have already eliminated the change fees, the only other perk that Southwest offers that others do not is 2 free checked bags, but even that is barely worth it anymore. I expect that other airlines will soon follow suit, and when that happens, it will be the end of Southwest if they do not improve their current practices. I applied for, and have received the chase sapphire card which will allow me to accrue points that can be used for any of the airlines. In the meantime, I am looking at baggage shipping services as a way to deal with the baggage fees.

header: Your staff were amazing and so very nice!
content: This is to the actual employees who were there and not your CEO who I find a big fat liar! Southwest employees, I know you had some problems weekend before last. I just want to say that my flights on the 15th from Reno to LAX and 16th from LAX to El Paso went so wonderfully. I was traveling with my 1 yr old granddaughter. You guys made it so much easier with her. We were running late due to extra time at security and you actually held up for us while we ran across the terminal. Your staff were amazing and so very nice! Thank you for that! I know times aren’t easy and your working while fighting for your own rights and freedoms, so I just want to say thank you for all your help. We will see you on our flights back the 1st and 2nd of November!

Still sitting in the airplane 2 hours after boarding. First hold up was supposedly because extra maintenance checks had to be done for over an clean flights. Second hold up was for weight and balance issues. They were literally moving 5 people around the plane and there were only 10 empty seats total. Then as we are pushing back from the gate the pilot comes on and says he is out of hours. We were 10 ft from the gate and he pulled back up and got off. 20 minutes later a new captain comes on and basically has to start all over. Just got word that they were topping off the gas. How is it you have to top off the gas if we were pushing from the gate 45 minutes ago. Southwest really needs to look at their management and processes. This is definitely a 1 star flight.

header: I will never fly Southwest again
content: I cannot believe I trusted Southwest with a short flight. I am beyond frustrated at being delayed twice and hearing multiple people also have experienced this multiple times from Southwest. As an airline company, the one thing to get right is being able to adhere to scheduled times. There are many people who rely on flight times for all sorts of events. I will never fly Southwest again.

header: I will never use Southwest again
content: I’ll never fly Southwest again. Booked a flight from Austin to Ontario and had a connection flight in Phoenix. The flight from Austin to Phoenix was delayed an hour and a half. Southwest then rebooked my flight from Phoenix to Ontario on another flight since the delay of the first flight was set to have me miss my original plane out of Phoenix. My original plane I was in group A. Southwest rebooked me and put me in group C as the last person on the plane. I mentioned that I was forced to this plane due to the airline’s own delay and was originally in group A, asking if I could get the same group for the new flight. The airline rep told me I “could if I pay for it.” What terrible customer service. Thanks for the delayed flight and then having me be the last person on the plane with the worst choice in seating on a full flight. You guys screwed up, yet I’m the one that gets the short end of the stick. Didn’t offer any kind of compensation/voucher, was rude, and Not trying to make right on their mistake. I will never use Southwest again. Worst airline ever.

I purchased my ticket the night before my flight (San Diego to Phoenix). After all the cancellations I felt this was a bad idea, but it’s a 1 hour flight. What could go wrong? Multiple delays. Insane. Southwest wants to keep pocketing money and cancelling flights. Total joke. Will never fly with these clowns again. Thanks for allowing me to be late for my sisters wedding, Southwest. Especially when I could have just made the 5hr drive.

header: What used to be a reputable airline is becoming a joke
content: 3 for 3 in last two months with being late on departure! What used to be a reputable airline is becoming a joke! I booked my flight for Christmas, and it wasn't on Southwest! They are right up there with Spirit Airlines.

First of all, they cancelled my flight at the last minute, then rescheduled me to a flight with little to no time to react...a flight that took me from Dallas to Nashville to Denver, arriving at 11:45 pm. Ridiculous. We are die hard SWA customers, but we have just about had it. Get your act together SWA!

header: Finally hung up and drove rental to destination
content: Horrible experience, canceled flight and told me to change my reservation. Attempted, but no flights available. Attempted to call and put on hold for almost 4 hours. Finally hung up and drove rental to destination.

header: this latest experience was not pleasing at all
content: I have been a long-time customer of Southwest Airlines, beyond satisfied, however, this latest experience was not pleasing at all. I made a reservation to visit my daughter in Los Angeles, CA for the 1st of September (Wednesday). She called me and said not come as she had tested positive for COVID. I immediately cancelled my reservations (Tuesday August 31st) and received a notification that they had been cancelled and the funds would remain for any future flights. That was 8/31/21. I got another email a few days later stating that my reservation had not been done in a timely manner, and that my funds were taken and I would not get a refund and/or credit. I called SWA Customer Service to dispute this and was not given any consideration. I’m 70 years old, on a fixed income and was not pleased with the outcome. I would hate to stop flying SWA, however (I‘ve worked in customer service for over 40 years), and would appreciate being given some satisfaction in this matter.

We have flown southwest for many years and have been very satisfied with their service in general. Just this past Sunday, oct. 10th we experienced the first cancellation ever. They were able to rescheduled my husband for a flight out the next day at 10:35am. He had a confirmed doctor's appointment and was able to make it. Not only did southwest rebook him and he made the appointment, but the also worke with him during the process and gave him a voucher for the inconvenience. Once again Southwest did their fine job. I just hope they resolve whatever issues they have and continue to fly safe and on time as they have always done.

This was the second leg of the trip - ORD/DAL/HOU (Flt 29). Full flight with open seating. The flight attendant who was standing at the forward galley as boarding was almost completed started singing - while her voice was/is good, it is not great. After serenading us, she then began to what amounted to a lecture on how we are all blessed and asked to the passengers to respond in the affirmative. In addition, we were told we were all loved, etc. It had the feel and sound of an evangelical Christian bible meeting. Several passengers passengers around me were shaking their heads in disgust while others were yelling "Praise Jesus". Unprofessional, insulting and narcissistic for her to think that we would want to hear her sing or preach. In addition, there is no service of any kind on the DAL/HOU/DAL leg. I do not understand why Southwest is popular - this is nothing more than a bus with wings. I will never purchase a ticket on WN or recommend them. I will stick to the legacy carriers such as American, etc.

header: canceled my flight two times already
content: Southwest has canceled my flight two times already. They don't send an email out until midnight. Wait times are crazy. Over 3 hours. Me and my family are stuck in Houston Texas and it has cost us over 1000 just for two days. We had to pay for hotel fees and rental car fees at the last minute due to southwest flight cancelation. We weren't offered any type of accommodations, only to rebook and when we do it gets canceled again at midnight.

Never ever flying Southwest again. They cancelled our flight last minute and we were told they can’t fly us home until two days later. When we asked for a hotel they said “all of our hotels are booked.” I demanded to speak with the manager who took 30 mins to come talk to us and acted like it was a big deal to get us a hotel. This airline refused to give us a credit to fly home today through another airline. We asked if they could fly us to somewhere near our home and they simply said “we don’t have anything.” Worst experience and ruined our vacation. Not only did we have to call off of work but we had to spend extra money for food and ubers.

header: never be flying with them again
content: We had been waiting in line to board the plane for about 15 minutes, the flight attendants were just standing there telling us nothing about what was going on! I kid you not, while in line to board the plane, they cancelled the flight! While we were in line to get on that flight. Even worse, they had already boarded our luggage on the plane and they wouldn’t un-board it! My family was stuck there for HOURS trying to figure out what to do. We ended up having to go on a train for 12 hours and picking up our luggage the next day from the flight they wouldn’t let us on. They flew the luggage but not the people. Apparently the day before our flight a bunch of air control people quit because of the vaccine requirements. There was no reason they couldn’t have cancelled the flight the day before it was supposed to take off. Worse, they won’t give us a refund! They’re offering us credits but we will never be flying with them again.

header: Southwest has quickly become the worst airline
content: Southwest has quickly become the worst airline. My last two flights I have booked a non stop flight to Phoenix and both times they have switched my flights to having one or two stops. This particular time I received an email at 1am stating my flight has been canceled for no reason. My wife has been on the phone for more then 9 hrs trying to talk to a representative and still no one has answered. At this time news outlets has stated that due to weather and air traffic control was the issue, so I drive to the airport and asked myself. They stated is was due to staffing issues? Why wouldn't they know that at 9pm when I last checked the flight status? When I talked to the ticket agent I was greeted with condescending answers and a attitude. Thanks again Southwest! So they rescheduled my flight - I now leave Tuesday, I have lost 2 days of my vacation, my rental car, and my time from work. As someone who works with the public my time is limited and for Southwest to show no remorse in their actions to help me. I will never fly Southwest again!

Horrible customer service. Flight was canceled twelve hours before flight. No flights for two days! Call and they can’t even pick up the phone. I have been a customer for many years and can now say I will never fly Southwest again. Would not recommend this airline.
Worst Airline on the planet, customer service is horrible, rude people. Had me on hold on the phone for almost 4 hours. I’m beyond furious. Never again Southwest Airlines.

header: Never will I use Southwest Ever Again
content: Got a text my flight was canceled with a link to reschedule - went to link and no flights available for 2 days. I do not have medication with me for 2 more days. In a hotel where the bill for two more days will be more than the flight. Meanwhile I have been on hold since 1:05 am and it is now 6:04. Never Have I Experienced with such Irresponsibility. Never will I use Southwest Ever Again.

Return flight scheduled for 10/9/2021 250. App notification flight delay approximately 1hr. Flight was cancelled. Notified to go to ticket counter. Waiting in line at ticket counter notified had to pickup luggage first prior to obtaining new flight, must retrieve my luggage first. So lost my place in line in order to get my luggage. My luggage came off last thus placing me at the end of line. Look on their website and there are no reservations available for the next day. So made reservations for the next day out of another airport. While holding on the phone. Was on hold over 8 hrs. Thought my reservations for the next day were confirmed. They totally changed my reservations to 2 days after confirmation was received. So again I’m on hold and I should be up in a few hours for what I thought was my new reservation. This is horrible customer service. I am so dissatisfied. What a waste of time and money.

Oct 9, 2021 flight #2451 departing at 5pm got canceled 3hrs before departure time Re-booked for 8:30pm flight# 1729 and 3 hours before departure time they send a message the flight was canceled too! Customer service are the worse. Very unreliable airline. Will never fly Southwest in my life!

We booked a round trip flight between Miami and Denver for our Denver vacation. The only reason we booked Southwest was for the nonstop flights. Both flights were cancelled within 30 minutes of the scheduled takeoff. The Miami to Denver flight was rescheduled with a layover, and the Denver to Miami was simply cancelled. Will never fly Southwest again; will never recommend Southwest. Thankfully they provided us with flight vouchers which we will happily never use. Southwest simply isn’t reliable. Do not book if you actually want to get where you are going.

Flight from Charleston South Carolina to St. Louis was cancelled at the last minute. Was never told why. The lack of information afterwards was completely unacceptable. Could not get anyone to tell us where to get our luggage as it had already been checked. Finally found our luggage at the carousel with no announcement. Will not fly Southwest again.

No issues from Jacksonville to Houston Hobby, but upon landing I received a text notification my flight to Oklahoma City has been canceled. Agent explained weather has affected flight coming out of Florida. Strange since I also flew out of Florida. She couldn’t get me into OKC until around 10.30 pm via Denver. My flight was scheduled to be in OKC about 12.30 pm. She could however get me to Tulsa earlier. What? I would be on my own from Tulsa. I had no option but to accepted the OKC via Denver route. At 12.25 pm I received a text notification the Denver flight had been canceled. Good grief! Now I’m on a 9.05 pm flight to OKC. Never an offer for any type of financial consideration or compensation even though I asked if SW would cover the rental car cost in Tulsa to get me to OKC. Pitiful customer service! Today, I would not recommend SW due to their lack of excellent customer service and uncaring attitude of ticket counter rep.

What has happened to Southwest? I used to love them and tell everyone to use them. Other than one international flight, I have been 100% loyal to them for 18 years. Now I am furious with them. I will be canceling my SWA credit cards, and they have lost me as a loyal customer. The last 10 flights I have been on have been delayed or canceled. And of course, no concessions for the customer. "Full Service" desk had 2 attendants and over 100 customers. Over an hour of waiting and I am not pleased. It's time to find a new carrier.

header: I will never fly Southwest again
content: Southwest canceled our flight 14 hours before takeoff. Then re booked us 3 days later! Online site kept giving error to try to rebook. Stayed on hold for 2 hours and then got disconnected. Now all flights full. Had to cancel flights and refund will take at least 30 days. Now having to rent car and drive 22 hours. Will actually cost more with rental, gas, hotel stay, and we lose a day on our house rental plus extra night hotel to come home. Just so very frustrating to have booked flights months ago. Horrible customer service, horrible online process. I will never fly Southwest again!

header: deeply disappointed in what was once America’s best domestic carrier
content: Southwest counter staff were rude, arrogant and appeared genuinely uninterested in our situation. We arrived at the airport 3 hours prior to departure to find no available airport parking, the shuttle from the Park-n-Fly dropped us at the wrong terminal, and security was severely backed up. We arrived at the gate 10 mins before departure and they had just closed the door. With both of us out of breath from running, my wife pleaded with them to let us board. The “Customer Service Supervisor” (Gate 10) appeared to relish her authority in refusing to open the door and let us board. She then spent a solid 30 minutes booking us on a flight for the following day. I explained that I could see same day flights available via the SW app and only then did she rebook me on a better itinerary. This is the 2nd bad experience on SW in the past 2 months and pre-Covid, I was an A-List flyer on SW. I’m deeply disappointed in what was once America’s best domestic carrier.

header: Why am I paying the extra $90-130 for business class?
content: I am an A list passenger with SW. I purchase the business class for quicker boarding, to insure I’m at the front. More and more these days, people are boarding during the pre-board segment I have noticed. This flight, there are 16 people, with 4 wheelchairs amongst them. That's more people than business class. I think SW should be vetting the pre-board people a little closer. Why am I paying the extra $90-130 for business class?

I have been flying a lot as of lately and 9/10 the flights have been delayed! Air conditioning has not been turned on while sitting on a crowded flight, beverages not offered, it is very disappointing. Unfortunately, this is one of the few airlines that flies into the small airport I need to use but I will not fly Southwest if other airlines are an option!!!

Late for no reason. Kept changing the departure time and never told us what was going on or why. After boarding we just sat there for 30 min. No announcement - nothing. Baggage staff took their sweet time putting the bags under the plane, had zero sense of urgency. I had an appointment that I had over an hour and a half of leeway to get to. Thanks. I missed it. I will never fly this airline again.

header: She outright refused to do anything
content: I have liked flying Southwest until this trip. Our first suitcase came out open, yes unzipped along with many others where you could see the clothing inside, and ours was also cut in an 'L' shape. I left my husband and daughter while I went to file a claim. No one was in the baggage service area and when I went to enter to call out another SW employee told me not to enter. Showed this SW employee my issue and she told me to wait the lady would 'know' I was there. I asked how she would know as this person had not notified anyone, there was no doorbell or cameras. She replied the lady would just know. A psychic I guess. While waiting my daughter called hysterical as her lacrosse sticks had not come out with her teammates and the conveyor belt had stopped. When we found it that person was rude as well and stated all sticks come out at over-sized baggage and we should have known that. Guess they forgot to tell our team as all the rest of the lacrosse sticks in lacrosse stick bags like hers did and have never before or again come out in over-sized baggage. Hers was the only stick bag to come out at over-sized luggage and only that one time. When the baggage service lady finally showed up, the two SW employees had to converse first about how I was waiting and not happy, making me wait even longer. When she did finally come over she refused, not once, but several times to fill out a ticket on my issue. She said open and cut luggage was not a valid claim. She outright refused to do anything. It gets better folks, I called SW and was being on hold a very long time. Finally, someone gets on the phone listens to my issues and than proceeded to tell me the people were not SW employees, but employees of BWI and I had to make a claim with BWI. When I pointed out all the employees I was calling about all wore SW uniforms she proceeded to enter my complaint about their rude customer service, but told me I had to do my own for the luggage. I did per her instructions. SW responded to the rude complainant with a letter stating they were sorry I was inconvenienced with a delay in my flight and offered me a SW credit. The luggage complaint they noted as complete without any letter, conversation, funds for new luggage or anything. I filed another complaint to comment on this incorrect form letter and the luggage issue to hear nothing from SW as it is now September with no reply.

header: had left my phone on the plane
content: I trusted Southwest until a flight from Love Field to BWI September 16 2021 arriving 11:15 PM. Within five minutes of deplaning I realized I had left my phone on the plane. Unfortunately I had left the secure area so I could not return to Gate A 10 where the plane was located. I was directed by Southwest personnel to go to the baggage claim office to receive assistance. The three workers at baggage claim were admittedly dealing with a disgruntled employee and stated they could not help me at the time because they were "too busy". In fact the supervisor reprimanded me for leaving the phone on the plane and claimed it was my own fault for being so stupid. Despite resistance I insisted that a missing item claim be filed at the office before I departed the airport. I waited at baggage claim until 2:00 AM when an employee reportedly searched the plane only to find no cell phone. When I obtained access to my computer at 3:00 AM that morning I searched FIND MY PHONE, to discover my phone located at the Southwest baggage claim. I returned to the Southwest baggage claim the next morning and I showed them on my computer where my phone was located according to FIND MY PHONE. They told me they did not have my phone and that they could not help me. I then went to the police. They accompanied me to the SOUTHWEST baggage claim. He told me to stay outside the office and push my phone to ring on the FIND MY PHONE app, which I did. The police came out of the office and told me that my phone was in the office. When I went into the office to get my phone one employee verbally attacked me with comments such as "you were the irresponsible one who lost your phone" . Furthermore they justified themselves that their job was baggage claim, not lost and found? They would not verify to me where or when the phone had been found.

Southwest cancelled 2 of my flights in the last month just hours prior to the flight leaving. They blame it on weather. United had no trouble taking us as we had to pay through the nose to fly last minute. I used to sing their praises, not any more. Cost me a small fortune. Cancelling their credit card and never flying them again. Use them if you don't need to get where you are on time or when you want. Hopefully the competition will put them out of business.

header: What's the point of paying premium money
content: I flew with my 11 year old who is on the spectrum takes ADHD medicine and has anxiety! When a gate attendant allowed us to pre-board, another one, right at the time of entry said we shouldn't be pre-boarding and kind of implied that we are abusing the pre-boarding option! Second time from Seattle to Nashville I bought 3 premium tickets and was among the first 5 to board, then I was told that I am carrying more luggage on myself and should consolidate between my son, my mother, who has shoulder pain! What's the point of paying premium money when you have to take their hassle.

header: they have clearly gone way downhill
content: Terrible. Flew my daughter home for a very short visit. Allowed over an hour between connecting flights. Flight out of Portland was delayed over an hour, and instead of holding the connecting flight for 10 minutes, they made everyone take another flight. Now my daughter has to take two more flights to get here, and will be arriving five hours (maybe) late! That's if the other flights are on time! This has happened too many times with Southwest. I have always loved them, but they have clearly gone way downhill. You can no longer count on leaving or arriving when scheduled. I am canceling my credit card with SW and going to a different airline.

header: would not let me on the plane
content: My flight was supposed to leave out of Gate 12 at 7:40 PM flying tonight from San Diego to Reno. At exactly 710 my flight had not boarded and I went to see what the matter was. Apparently they change the gate to a separate terminal without notifying me. I ran to gate eight and made it there by 7:30 PM on the dot plane was already boarded and they would not let me on the plane. Southwest reps did not display any compassion nor help me find a solution. I feel Southwest could’ve done a better job at resolving the matter. Especially since I arrived at The gate a full 10 minutes before it was even supposed to leave. not fair.

header: it’s not fair to us loyal customers
content: I have flown SW for over 10 years faithfully. This trip from Aruba on 9-5-21 was the worst flight attendants ever. None of them looked like they wanted to be at work yesterday. The plane wasn’t even full and they only offered drinks once on a four hour flight. I’m also amazed how many people get early boarding since most of the huge adults walked down the jet way without assistance. As someone who always pays extra to get a A seating assignment it’s not fair to us loyal customers. Do you even have documents from their MD with the reason they need to board before those who pay extra! They should have a MD excuse to get on early, these people were all in one group, knew everyone and traveled together. So can I use my BMI of 2 over normal as a reason to get on first in the front 5 rows? Or maybe my A1C level is slightly elevated or that I have to take Lipitor because my cholesterol is high. A passenger had to notify a flight attendant that someone sitting in an aisle seat wasn’t wearing his mask after she walked past him! Seriously? Something needs to done to those passengers who are lying about their need to board before those who pay extra for early bird seating. Medical need to board early should have to be presented at the gate before they board prior those loyal customers earned a companion pass prior to covid!

Forget every positive experience about the Old Southwest, and erase those high reviews. Those days are over, and it's the end of an era. They should change their name to Scrubwest airline, because there is a high percentage your flight this Fall is going to get scrubbed. It will either get canceled, or they will move it to a new time that is often impossible to meet. If you complain by email, they will offer you $150 on another flight. Southwest apparently thinks "buying out" customers will work, completely ignores the reality that many of us have only specific times to fly. Plus, that future flight will probably just be canceled too, so what's the point? The brand name has been destroyed. A web search with a timeline of August 2021 or September 2021 will confirm I'm not alone in this experience, and that it's now common to many Southwest fliers.

I will never be flying on Southwest again! They forgot to fuel the aircraft my first flight so that delayed me 2 hours which then made me miss my other flight, so instead of giving me the next closest flight. They give me the last flight out. Then when I got into that flight which they already messed all of my plans for the day because I was supposed to land @ 10 now I’m still at the airport all day, the flight I’m about to board has something wrong with the plane so I’m now delayed again, I have a hotel room booked which is pointless know because I won’t be there till 2 am. Overall worse experience flying in my life & I’ve been flying for years. Seats are terrible as well. Do not book this airline, front desk workers are terrible at their job as well!

header: not getting refunded the additional charge
content: My family and I had a flight booked for $949.90. The flight was scheduled to leave early Monday morning. We discovered it was cancelled around 3am Monday morning. We tried to schedule a different flight from Albany to Orlando but the next flight wasn’t until Wednesday, meaning we would miss 1/3rd of our prepaid Disney vacation. We called southwests customer service but there was a 2 hour wait. We ultimately booked a flight out of Hartford, CT to Orlando. This flight cost $2,844.90 nearly $2000 more than the initial flight. We had to have a family member drive us to Hartford to get the flight. While driving to Hartford we called the southwest customer service number back. I explained the situation and expected them to say they would quickly refund the $2,844.90. To my surprise the person told me I had two options. 1- she could only refund the $949.90 (the cost of the initial flight and I would have to pay the $2,844.90, meaning the vacation would cost me nearly $2000 more than I budgeted or 2- she could book the next flight from Albany to Orlando, two days later (causing my family to miss two days of our prepaid vacation). I asked if I could speak with a supervisor but she said she is a supervisor and she could not refund the $2,844.90. I told her I planned a vacation with my young family a long time ago and the plane having technical difficulties wasn’t my fault, and I had to have a family member take the day off work to drive me to Hartford. She said my only other option was to send a message to the customer service department which would be responded to within 10 days. I told her it was unacceptable, I have to spend time on my family vacation putting in the complaint and not knowing if I’m being charged an additional $2000! After about two weeks I got an email, after asking for a call, and was told I’m not getting refunded the additional charge. Vacation cost $2000 more than expected.

header: I was not wearing a mask
content: We booked a roundtrip flight From Colorado Springs to the Las Vegas. For the return flight, my wife and I were kicked off the flight and stranded in Vegas with no way to get home. The flight attendant (I wish I got her badge number) grabbed me by the arm and told me I was harassing the patrons which is 100% untrue. We got pulled aside as we were boarding because I was not wearing a mask, and the manger was called. After I spoke with a manger, I put the mask on and was one of the last ones to be able to board the flight. My wife asked the lady next to her if she would trade seats with me so we could sit next to each other. She told my wife, "no problem" even though I was in a middle seat, and as we were passing each other in the isle, I asked her again if she was sure she was ok with switching me seats, and that is when the flight attended grabbed me by the arm and said to get off the flight, and that I was being deboarded for "harassments". When I got out of the tunnel, I went to the manger and expressed my concern about my luggage that was under the plane, and at that point he said if I do not get away from him he would call the police and have me arrested. So there we were with no flight home.

Worst experience ever. My wife and I were supposed to fly to Denver then LA. We were rerouted to a Dallas then El Paso. No big deal. During flight our mask came down to the end of our nose, mine once, hers once and we were told to keep our mask up. When we landed in El Paso apparently the 2 stewardesses that asked us to keep our mask up went and got one of their superiors. This was the craziest experience of our life. The lady came on the plane and went crazy on us. Threatening us with “throwing us off the plane” making a huge scene, trying to get us to argue with her, which neither of us would do. This went on for about 3 minutes. Then she gets us another mask because I explained that my mask may have come down to the end of my nose because it was cloth. She went crazy again. Said put this mask on I replied ok. “Is this good”. She said don’t argue with me. “I’ll throw you off this plane”. Never seen anyone over 8 years old act like this. We were embarrassed for her. Never again Southwest.

We had a flight that was delayed 6 times. It started with a boarding time of 4:30 pm by the time we boarded it was after 9:30 pm. While our flight was being delayed 2 other airplanes were also delayed. One was canceled completely. While we sat and waited the 5 hours we sat by Southwest gate. The whole 5 hours there was one lady (Paulette). All I can say is Paulette was by far the best customer service agent I have ever seen in action for that length of the 5 hours. I heard every kind of excuse, lie, complaining and down right ugliness by a lot of the travelers. She never once lost her cool. She was friendly to the worst kind. She was so helpful to anyone she could help (she tried hard for everyone) regardless how rude they were to her. I am not going to say it was a great day it wasn’t. It was a long bad day. Saying all that, Paulette made me believe that no matter the situation we can be great under the worst situation! Thank YOU Paulette.

header: wait an hour and a half for our checked bags
content: I will start by saying I rode comfortably for the 4 hour flight. The staff on the flight was very courteous as well. Although drinks and food were limited, this is what we have come to expect in a post COVID world. It was after the flight that there were problems. We had to wait an hour and a half for our checked bags to make it to the baggage claim. There was no explanation given other than sorry, the guys in the back getting luggage up here is put of my hands. When you are getting in at midnight and having to work in the morning an extra hour and a half is a big deal.

header: Southwest needs to get it together
content: I initially left from Rochester on 8/12 and when checked in was told my bag might not be on the flight, and that I’ll have to possibly go back and get it. Well 8/23 the flight was supposed to depart at 9:45pm. It is now 10:37pm and the plane is just leaving. The delay is due to other passengers bags needing to get on the flight. I think this is sad holding over 60 passengers up, when I was told that I would possibly have to go back to get my luggage. So why were they not told the same. Apologies don’t help when you make plans accordingly and the plane is the reason for delay. Southwest needs to get it together. Several complaints all summer. Oh wait now it’s another 15 minute delay.

header: I wouldn’t fly this airline again
content: Flight was delayed for over 3 hours originally, when we were finally allowed to board, there was another hour wait until they could locate a pilot. It was then we were informed that instead of having one stop, they added a second stop in AZ with no explanation. Customer service has had us on hold for well over 50 minutes now and the employees have been ridiculously unhelpful. We are then told that the WiFi in the plane does not work so there will be no inflight entertainment. I wouldn’t fly this airline again.

Flight to Orlando was quick with chips and small shared cup of drink.  My return flight experience was so so below par. They cancelled my 9:30pm from Orlando to Indy just 1 hr to boarding that I already arrived at airport after changing and changing time and I didn't bother and they rebooked me to 7:35am following morning I woke up with my wife and 1 year old and 4 years old girls at 4:30am just to be prepared after leaving to airport they cancelled my flight again and rescheduled me to 11:45. Instead of direct flight they put us on 7hrs 50 minutes, 1 stop flight and I was supposed to resume work. I went to claim my luggage and my bag is damaged.

header: stuck at the airport for almost 24 hours
content: My flight got canceled the night before and Southwest decided not to let anyone know until 30 minutes before the flight. The lady at the desk was so rude and said I had to deal with it because the crew was tired and didn’t want to work. I understand that flights get canceled, but let people know ahead of time. My nearest airport is 45 minutes away and now I’m stuck at the airport for almost 24 hours.

header: at 1:15 the flight had already left
content: I’ve never missed a flight in my entire life until today because when I reported to the gate at 11:45 for a 12:35 flight the associate told me the plane wouldn’t be boarding until 1:30 pm because it was running late so I go get a bite to eat and return at 1:15 the flight had already left. I’ve been flying since I was in diapers and never missed a flight. I can’t count how many times I wouldn’t leave the gate if I was there two hours before the flight. I am a very cautious prompt person. I arrived at this airport almost three hours before scheduled departure and that employee should not gave me that long of a time frame and now I won’t arrive in Dallas until 8:35 instead of 4:35. This just shows the competency and assumption of workers, I get to spend eight hours here in Nashville and it caused my evening business plans to be able to happen.

header: SWA did great with contacting us
content: Booked 4 one way flights with SWA. Our first flight from TPA-DEN was smooth. Flight on time, service in flight was great. Next flight from DEN to Phoenix was delayed 4 times then canceled. No other flights to PHX were available that and next day so we were put on flight to SLC. We boarded that flight sat in he plane for one hour then flight was canceled. Anyway we got to SLC next day. Lost almost 2 days of our travel, couldn’t get refund for our hotel. I contacted SWA and we got ton of vouchers for future flights, even voucher for lost hotel funds. Yes this experience was unpleasant but SWA did great with contacting us and make it right. I will fly with them without hesitation. This situation happens and I do not harbor any bad feelings towards the airline.

I expected to fly straight to San Diego from SLC but The plane arrived in Denver. I had to get off the plane and ran as fast as I can to the gate. The gate already opened. I was kind of nervous break down.  I bought ticket from SLC to SAN to HNL. Why stopped in Denver?? I dislike Southwest Airlines business. Not very impressive! I will never use Southwest Airlines again!

I am not sure what has happened to Southwest Airlines but they have hit rock bottom! I am A list preferred and have traveled with them for years. The last 4 months have been a nightmare. 4 of my last 6 flights have been over 2 hours late. The other two were not even remotely on time. They keep giving me vouchers but what would I use them for? Those flights would be late as well and the experience would be just as poor. They have a serious issue with having enough crew to make flights. This last flight from Dallas to KC will be my last with them. They are truly the worst.

Over the past year and half, my husband and I have flown many times on Southwest, and prior to the Covid pandemic, Southwest was always our airline of choice for domestic flights. The pandemic changed things, quite understandably, and we have had patience in what we know has been a difficult situation. However, the past several flights we have completed with Southwest have definitely taken turns for the worst in terms of customer service, with flights being rescheduled without notification to us, re-routing us to flights that are not non-stop (when our originally booked flights were nonstop), returning us to our home town in the middle of the night (when our originally-purchased itinerary arrived late afternoon), losing our luggage, etc. But this is finally the last straw. We will not be flying Southwest again. In June, my mother passed away. The memorial service is scheduled to take place on August 8th. In July, as soon as the memorial service dates were confirmed, we booked our flights back to Portland from Colorado for the memorial service. Twenty-four hours before our flight time, we checked in, as is the usual routine with Southwest. We were assigned seats. Some hours later, we received the usual emails with reminders for timeliness of arrival to the airport for our flight, mask requirements, etc. Now, less than 8 hours prior to our flight departure time, we checked our flight status to give my family final updates for our arrival time only to find that Southwest has canceled our flight. All other flights from Denver to Portland within the next 24 hours are listed by Southwest as "Unavailable." We called the "Contact Us" number for Southwest Airlines to try to figure out what we could do to rectify the situation. After sitting on hold for literally 2 hours (with what became an increasingly annoying message about how sorry Southwest was for the delay and that they would be "right with us, as soon as possible"), we finally gave up and hung up. While sitting on hold, we found and booked a flight on a different airline, at last minute prices with luggage fees, etc. This behavior by Southwest Airlines is profoundly unprofessional and completely unacceptable. It breaches the contract Southwest Airlines entered into with us, as its passengers, of a service they were to provide (transportation from Colorado to Oregon), paid for in advance, with the express understanding that the service would, in fact, be provided. At the very least, timely notice of the inability to provide the service should have been provided, along with an explanation as to why the service was canceled at the last minute with literally no notice to us of the cancellation. No offer of restitution or alternative transportation has been made, and Southwest has refused to provide any sort of customer service (although I'm sure that no one could be paid enough to have to deal with customers treated in such a fashion by their employer). After going on line and reading recent Washington Post (among others) articles, we now see that Southwest has been doing this to its customers for the past several months. They certainly won't be doing it for very much longer, because they will be out of business soon. You cannot treat your customers like this and expect to continue to have any. In a customer-service oriented business such as the passenger airlines are, the death knell for Southwest Airlines is surely tolling.

header: easy to book, easy to change
content: I flew 89 times in 2019 and I've been a consistent flier, with advantaged airline miles at 3 airlines. Southwest is easy to book, easy to change, easy to add companions and the two bags thrown in for free really simplify my travel when I bring my e-bike to new cities. It is simple to use, with one glaring exception. I get why they do it, and once you have A-list status with them you can take advantage of it, but the boarding system is embarrassing, complicated, and really cutthroat. Do a bit of research before you do your first flight. Domestically, I will likely only fly other airlines if I absolutely have to.

header: never fly with Southwest Airlines again
content: I will never fly with Southwest Airlines again. There was no assigned seating so me and my husband sat in separate rows. Snacks were terrible! Staff looked and acted as if they did not want to be there. Delayed flight.

header: customer care has gone down the drain
content: Pre-pandemic I was always flying Southwest with my family. I loved the free bags and no extra fees. I always had great customer service too. I used to recommend Southwest to everyone. Well let me tell you, no more! Their service, quality, and customer care has gone down the drain! I finally got to visit my family this summer after a year and a half of not seeing most of them due to the pandemic. Myself and my three boys traveled to our destination via American Airlines. Had no issues there - great service and a nice plane! On the way back, however, I traveled via Southwest. Unbeknownst to me they had changed my nonstop flight to a flight with one stop in Orlando. I found this out when checking on my flight a few days before. Now in their defense, I searched my email and they had notified me of this change back in the beginning of May via an email that I am fairly certain ended up in my promotions folder instead of my inbox or else I would have seen it. The thing that urked me is that they made this change the day after I bought my 3 nonstop tickets. The day after their sale ended, they decided to get rid of a bunch of nonstop flights. How convenient for them... Not so much all of us who booked with them because we wanted a nonstop flight. I was hoping they had one this week that I could change it to, but nope. Checked their website - none. Now mind you, I was traveling alone with three boys. My oldest is 6 and the other two are both under the age of 2 (a 21 month old and a 6 month old). If you are a parent, you understand how difficult this could be. I waited on hold for almost 2 hours just for them to tell me they could refund my tickets, but if I used flight credit it would stay as flight credit (not helpful as they have no nonstop flights on this route anymore). They said they "temporarily" got rid of nonstop flights from their schedule. I looked at my options for the week and either the layovers were way too short to make it to the other plane for us or they were long and required even more flight time. Needless to say, I had to keep my flight. By then other airlines were too expensive and Southwest said they could not book us on another airline. I was told this before I even asked so you know a bunch of people must have asked this. I haven't gotten to the worst part yet.. We had a fine first flight to Orlando. A little over two hours. They kept changing the time but ended up boarding on time after all. We made it to Orlando and our stroller was already waiting for us when we got off the plane. Kudos to Orlando people. Flying to Dallas was a different story. We were sitting in the plane an hour before we took off. This was due to the weather, so that, I understand. This was another 2 and a half hour flight as well. My poor kids were doing fairly well despite traveling all day. (Remember, two of them are a young toddler and a baby.) Near the end of the flight while we had been traveling for over 11 hours already one of the flight attendants remarks about the mess we had made (my toddler spilled some chip crumbs on the floor) and said that we would have to clean it up, but she said it in a passive aggressive way and asked if we needed.

I’ve always been pretty happy with Southwest Airlines. I use them a lot and they are typically my airline of choice. Overall, the staff is friendly, and the flights are on time. We recently got delayed in Denver due to severe weather. They comped us $100 vouchers even though they didn’t have to which is very nice. My only criticism is the ticket booth at Las Vegas. The past two times, it’s a bit of a nightmare. There seems to be no sense of urgency to get people through the line, and in both cases, it was very busy, and they had two ticketing booths open and one of the desk clerks kept walking away. Super stressful when you have a flight to make.

header: I will never fly southwest again
content: I flew southwest 6 months pregnant with my husband, 11 year old son, and 2 year old daughter returning home to Orlando from Portland Oregon after coming from my mother passing away on 7/30/21. Our flight was scheduled to leave Portland at 2:00pm which was only delayed 30 minutes (no big deal). The lay over was in Denver we get off the plane with 30 minutes to spare before our connecting flight was suppose to take off to find out our flight had been canceled and was not leaving until 6:00am the next morning. We are then told to go wait in the customer service line for 45 minutes to get told we can’t have a partial refund, hotels would not be accommodated, and the flight in the morning would be taking us to Indianapolis then Orlando instead of our original flight which was straight from Denver to Orlando. The customer service representative cut me off and stated that they only had 4 spots on this plane so I needed to tell her if I wanted to be on the plane or not. They told us the flights were canceled due to weather but there was no bad weather in Denver or Orlando. My family and I went to the 3rd floor sat in seats and walked my 2 year old around in the stroller until she fell asleep for exactly 1 hour, no one else slept at all. We were able to leave at 5:30am with a flight going straight to Orlando, I got sick from lack of sleep literally the morning of before we got on the plane, my daughter, husband and son are all sick now but thankfully we made it home the next day by 12:00pm. I think it’s highly unprofessional to drastically change someone’s flight to the next day when they land and then try and make them pay for a hotel. I think had I not been pregnant and had my 2 year old with me, and returning home from a family death it wouldn’t have been as bad but I have no idea what happened to customer service. I will never fly through Denver again ( I know better) and I will never fly southwest again (3rd strike for me).

They are so disorganized and can't seem to make a flight on time. No one seems to know anything and they just have you sit on a plane for an hour for luggage due to them causing a previous plane to be late because they chose to argue with a customer about a mask instead of just remove the customer. Therefore screwed up the entire flight and just left us for an hour on a plane for 10 pieces of luggage. Do not fly Southwest.

I had a flight for 9 AM and received a text at 630 that the flight was changed to 1 PM. I changed my shuttle service to leave my home at 10 AM. I am over an hour away from airport. I then get a text at 830 AM stating that my flight departure time changed back to 10AM making it impossible for me to make this flight. Now I can’t fly out until 845 PM. When you make a change you shouldn’t change it back. This is ridiculous. I am so dissatisfied in your service.

header: can't seem to figure out flight schedules
content: I won't get in to the fact that their flight attendants no longer seem to take care of passengers like they appreciate the fact that we have a choice and we choose to fly with them. Or that for a family of four it's quite expensive to fly and would be nice to be treated with friendliness. What I am writing about is the fact that they can't seem to figure out flight schedules before publishing them, resulting in my family losing an entire day during a vacation that folks save up for years for. Not their problem, because hey, they can get you on the same flight a day earlier. But what they won't do is pay for a condo reservation that was booked under the pretense that we would be staying that extra day, which is past the point of being refundable. Call customer service you ask?  What a joke. After waiting on hold for over an hour, they direct you to the customer care line, where you get to wait on hold for over four hours just to be told the same thing. And, they aren't even willing to waive the additional cost to switch to a different SW flight!
