(flight not even close to full) He stopped me and asked me to please put my purse into my backpack. My purse and backback are small, i am a small person, nothing was even hanging outside of my person. Both items were so empty they easily fit together. Both items tucked under the seat did not even fill 50 percent of the space. Why did he even bother? Why did he have to make one person's experience less than pleasant. In B 21 I was the last person. Flight was not even half full. There's no good reason for him to do what he did. The lady with 4 bags was so loaded down in size and bulk that she held up the entire plane for deplaning. She couldnt carry her items front ways or sideways! But me, small items that were tucked onto my person, me he HAD to target!? He does not represent Southwest well at all and should receive the same training countless others before him have been given. Southwest is by far the best airline my family ever travels and the poor actions of this fellow are an embarrassment to the company.

I'm writing this with a heavy heart and a serious headache. I booked a flight on Mar 27 for May 11 on April 5th southwest changed the flight. I got an email and was told to rebook online at no additional cost. By that time Jamaica had closed the boarder and the situation was so uncertain so I asked to be refunded instead of changing or being credited. They told me no my only options were the two previously stated. I told them that it was unfair for me to be stuck on their timeline since it was ever changing. Anyway with no other option I revoked for May 22. That was canceled and I got an email notification. I changed again to June 6. Now june 6 was being held based on the multiple conversations I had with CSR. I applied for my leave days and everything based on the information provided by their app stating that my flight was still on. A few days before my flight I called southwest because of an Instagram post I saw about international flights entering orf having issues only to find out that my flight was canceled days before without notification. I lost wage revenue since my leave days were already booked with my company and now I have to request additional days to actually going to VA. Then they called and offered me a voucher like that was somehow going to help my situation. I cant pay bills or eat using a southwest travel voucher. I'm extremely disappointed and upset.

Southwest in the middle of a global pandemic is stealing customer’s money, the airline is are begging for tax payer bail outs but refusing to work with customers when they have elderly or family member with serious medical conditions that make it unsafe for them to fly with the covid-19 fully knowing that people with compromised immune systems are at a higher risk. I’m sorry to rant but this is frustrating we should not allow these airline companies steal from Tax Payers and then turn around and beg for a bail out.

Incredibly disappointed in a company I’ve trusted for so many years. A company known for outstanding customer service. Southwest Airlines not only cancelled my late July flight with no notice, when I log into my account to book another flight is when I see I have no upcoming trips so I call customer service only to be told sorry it’s out of our control we can issue you a refund within 30 days. It certainly didn’t take them 30 days to collect my money when I trusted them to book a flight with them. Unfortunately they have permanently lost a customer, not acceptable Southwest Airlines.

header: behave in a really human manner
content: Tampa to Havana. I been traveling continuously with Southwest airline since 12/2016 once a month at least. The most remarkable thing i like about this airline its that every single time i traveled have been a "on time" flight. Other than a rude employee at TSA checking process never had a complaint. Last February 27 i did have a really stressful situation on board when my Son who have ASD (autism spectrum disorder) did not board the plane, even when he pass true TSA checking and was lined up at the boarding gate. All the sudden he disappear,at that time i was on board already. That situation make me feel a lot of emotions, from panic, shame, frustration etc. After 45 minutes of desperation the manager on charge have talk to me in a kindly manner and she offer to travel the next morning with out any charge. Even when there where some unconsidered and rude passengers on board they clarify that my son its a high sensitive passenger and they cant just depart with out take any action, at least look for him in the gates area. in my experience,they behave in a really human manner, more than just worried about business. For a LOT of reasons but this one specifically i have to THANKS all and every single one Southwest employees.

header: Bad service and bad website function
content: The problem is really with the website and customer service. I was charged more than expected when I booked online, I had called to get it fixed and it was only partially addressed as I discovered when my credit card statement arrived. I called again and after spending an hour on the phone, I was told by the agent that he could not help me with anything involving charges to my credit card. I was stunned that we had spent so much time on the phone if he couldn't help with my issue. I asked why he didn't tell me this within the first few minutes of our call and he claimed that he wasn't allowed to tell me this. I asked him how he was allowed to tell me when he did if he wasn't allowed to tell me earlier and he said he didn't know but that was how he was told to do his job. The other scary part of this is even though I was using travel funds to pay for a ticket and the funds completely covered the cost of this ticket and yet somehow the system was able to charge my credit card without me entering the security code and approving the charge. Bad service and bad website function. They also charged me for early bird checking when they knew I wouldn't need it - I am disabled so I get to pre-board.

header: charge me a fee to refund my points
content: My review has nothing to do with my last flight from Kansas to Seattle it has everything to do with my up coming trip from Kansas to New Orleans. My husband and I were set to go on a cruise leaving June 7th the cruise line canceled our trip due to COVID 19. I called to cancel our flight and they want charge me a fee to refund my points back to my account. I trip to talk to the SW representative and she hung up on me. I am a long time SW card holder and with the way I was treated I will be paying my card off and closing my account. Very rood and unacceptable behavior from SW customer service.

header: truly the best of the best
content: St Louis to Phoenix. Southwest really shows “luv” for its customers. In my opinion, they are truly the best of the best, sure there may be no meals, but for the lowest price possible you still get free drinks, a pleasant experience and free entertainment. Southwest also has no change fees, no baggage fees and amazing customer support. I’m from St. Louis and we don’t have a very big airport, but Southwest still is able to fly me anywhere in the country from my home airport, directly to where I’m going. On top of everything Southwest has the best flight attendants, they are so nice, caring and attentive. I can see why people only fly Southwest. Some people love all the features of other airlines but I think you should get out of your comfort zone and see the Southwest difference.

Much to my chagrin, Southwest has pulled the rug from under my feet. My well planned vacation to the wonderful world of Disney is falling apart. All because of Southwest Airlines' villainous change to my pre booked and confirmed airline flight that occurs two months from now. This shows a complete disregard for their loyal customers. Do we mean nothing to them? They changed a 10 o'clock flight to 7:30 am without my consent. Obviously for nothing but their own convenience. How am I supposed to drop my pooches off at their home away from home? This will not be possible now. Do they even care? From their email notification that I received after they changed the time, it does not appear so. Whatever executive made this horrendous decision should be shamed. I wish I could talk to their mother/parental figure and give them a piece of my mind. I have been on Southwest previously in my life, and their service was perfectly fine, but this experience has changed my opinion of them. Such a shame.

header: no one I spoke with showed an ounce of concern
content: Worst experience ever! I was exposed to Covid and on doctors orders to stay in until further notice. Not only that but the destination of my trip had implemented a 14 day quarantine upon arrival. What am I supposed to do for 14 days in Texas? Missed flight for return and unprecedented expenses. How inconvenient not to consider refunds for lost causes. The customer service was down right rude and no one I spoke with showed an ounce of concern! I’m going to tell my story to anyone who will listen. This is ludicrous. A pandemic breaks out and a company that is receiving bailout from the government chooses to be greedy and not refund when families need their funds more now than ever. I’m off work, my husband off work and your organization won’t even display the decency to have a manager talk with an escalated call. Sorry Southwest! Y’all are officially trash!

Tampa to Birmingham. My wife and daughter were scheduled to attend a gymnastic competition in Birmingham, Ala. The event was cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. I thought that a refund would be given, especially since it was cancelled because of a pandemic, but they are telling no refund, we will give a credit that has an expiration date. This is unfair and shows a serious lack of concern for customers and I want to make sure that the word gets that, Southwest doesn`t really care about you and your situation, only their bottom line.

Pittsburgh to Orlando. This review is not about my last flight, it is about the flight I had to cancel because of COVID 19 and my stepson having down syndrome. I have spoken with a few different representatives and only one has given me the feeling that she cares about me and my family but she doesn’t have the power to help! It seems all they care about is their money. With COVID 19 being such a problem to people with a breathing issue. It is most likely that my stepson will never be able to fly. These tickets could be refunded or transferred To another name and Southwest will not even let me speak to a Sr Manager. They have just closed the account without speaking with me. This is a worldwide problem, people had to shut their lives down and taking care of a child with special needs has shut our family down for who knows how long. Southwest Has shown me what is important to them and it’s surely not family and taking care of family! I highly recommend looking at all of your flight options before taking your flight with such a company that doesn’t care about their customers.

Columbus to Montego Bay. Southwest Airlines is a great airline! In spite of the COVID19, they were still full of compassion and credited all of my monies and extended that credit through next year in June! Before COVID19 if Southwest didn't fly there then I didn't use any other airlines!

Never been impressed with Southwest. I was moving from Houston to Dallas and they canceled my flight and texted me to rebook. I rebook and arrive at the airport and during COVID 19 I am the only person at check-in. The guy who "helped" me was on a personal call the entire time and when I would ask him a question, he looked upset he had to stop talking to his friend! On top of that my plane was delayed over an hour when only 10 people were on the plane. I carried on my cat and after being in her pet carrier for too long, she limped for 2 days. They also charged me $95 to take her.

Chicago to Fort Myers. We had flown to Ft. Myers on March 8th 2020 before the lockdown was issued in states. As we approached our return flight home they kept cancelling our flight. They cancelled our flight three times before I said “I had enough” we needed to get home my 1 yr old daughter and I (pregnant) had doctor appointments. I booked a different airline and called Southwest to see if they could refund my money which I had to put more money in a return flight for 2 tickets one way then I did on my whole flights through Southwest. Now I’m out almost $300 dollars plus what I spent on 2 one way tickets through a different airline. I enjoy Southwest but in a pandemic where we were thousands of miles from home couldn’t help in any way. I’m disappointed how they are and was handling the situation of this pandemic.

Very disappointed with this airline. With everything going on today I would expect to see Southwest to have a little compassion and understanding with people needing to cancel their flights. My wife is 30 weeks pregnant and had a baby shower planned in April to fly to. Obviously that got cancelled. Southwest was at all no help and would not refund us. Thanks.

San Diego to Denver. Not getting a flight refund because we purchased "Wanna get away non refundable tickets" the trip is for May 5, 2020. for my elderly parents to come see their grandson graduate college, tickets were purchased in January 2020. When I tried to cancel them the response I received is "unfortunately you purchased non refundable tickets" they tell me if we cancel the reservation the funds will be saved for one year, minus $100.00 they can not give back, but not transferable. My elderly parents purchase their flight tickets even though they are on a fixed income, they are 90 years old. (I paid them back). this airline is a disgraceful, selfish, with no compassion. They care more about their rules and regulations rather than the people who are the ones that pay their salaries, the government for sure will bailed them out so they won't go under. I will never use this airline again

Chicago to Orlando. Southwest Airlines we were supposed to go to Florida March 17-March 24, obviously with a two-year-old with asthma who sees a pulmonologist for it every 3 months, a 6-month-old-baby and someone who is 69 and people with underlying conditions, we, unfortunately, had to make the choice to stay home during all of this. They will not refund our flights because we booked as a “group” we still paid $260 a flight and the best they will offer is new flights to go by May 30 - in the middle of a pandemic. They care more about money than the safety of humans. Seriously disgraceful - at least 5 of us have called them and got the same response that “you can email them but they don’t know if they will refund you” (my sister just got the email response that they will not). Our kids are already having a hard time with us having to cancel, disgraceful. I will never book Southwest again and before you do remember this, please.

header: not receive a full refund back
content: Ontario to Sacramento. Purchased tickets on 2/1/2020 for May 15-16 2020 needed to be cancelled due to news that my graduation ceremony would no longer be taking part from COVID-19 concerns. I called customer service who referred me to executive office. They informed me that because I purchased "non- refundable" tickets, I could not receive a full refund back on my card. They only offered travel funds for future use until June 30, 2021. This is unacceptable as I did not have any idea that this outbreak would occur and it is not the customers fault.  I have no history of complaining before and am shocked that Southwest could not make any exceptions during this difficult time. Southwest Airlines should be ashamed and embarrassed for the lack of sympathy and corporate greed they have portrayed.

header: used to prefer Southwest but no longer
content: After flying from Indianapolis to Atlanta we had a 4 hour layover until our flight to Oakland. My girlfriend has a service animal and we had to the bathroom. We were in Terminal C and there were no pet relief areas open in the entire terminal. We had to walk 20 minutes to terminal B to find an open pet relief area. When we came back they had closed the doors, 15 minutes before the flight. We explained to the lady at the gate that there were no pet relief areas open yet she would not let us on the plane. We then watched the plane for 15 minutes sitting and then it backed out and left. There was plenty of time to correct the situation. The representative laughed and said "Oh I figured you were walking your dog because I saw a service animal on your reservation." I fly twice a week and I used to prefer Southwest but no longer.

Nashville to Dallas. I had flights scheduled for Dallas and Napa. When I cancelled the flight because of the coronavirus I was told that the early bird fees of $50 per flight would not be transferred to the rescheduling of my flights. Feels like an old fashion holdup. Will not fly Southwest intentionally ever again if I do not at least get my early bird fees transferred to future flights. Bad publicity and customer relations for an airline that in the past had put customer first. They missed a tremendous opportunity to do the right thing.

header: the best flight I have ever been on
content: Although many are upset because of these trying times, I have to say while we flew Southwest Airlines from MDW to Punta Cana, flight 2692 and had a great flight. We had our grandchild with us which was his first flight and the crew could not have done enough. While in the Dominican we started hearing so many rumors that the borders were being shut down and we were basically being abandoned. Well Southwest answered their phones confirmed our flight back to the USA and yes we called numerous times as United abandoned everyone at our resort and many people were left scrambling for any airline to please take them back. our flight was the second to last flight back to the USA, and we had a first row seat and I cannot tell you how many people arriving on the plane Flight 517 kept on thanking Southwest for taking them home. Our family witnessed this personally and Southwest had flown many planes empty to the Dominican to bring our people home. The best part was the crew of this flight showed all of us so much attention, and treated everyone great. One passenger had her birthday party sung to her by the whole flight and the crew gave her a bit of a funny gift and one of the crew also sang, to the passengers. By far the best flight I have ever been on. I thank the pilots for their hard work and the crew who put so many people at ease for the great time and flight. I have and will anytime always fly with Southwest due to their great service. If I could I would give them more than 5 stars.

Chicago Midway to Denver. Adding my disappointment in what has been known as the airlines that have the best customer service and "caring" for their customers. I would expect them to take the lead on understanding and how they can help customers in these scary and challenging times. I also had an event canceled due to Coronavirus and it will not be rescheduled. So I will not be refunded. Or I can use this money for a year for something else, I guess I just pick a place to go to use the money, then also will have hotel and food fees, etc? we are not a family that can afford to just go somewhere to use this. Maybe something will come up that we have to go to in a year, who knows. But this has changed totally how I feel about Southwest Airlines and I will not choose them in the future.  American airlines refunded my friend for a cancellation due to Coronavirus. Wrong move Southwest, wrong move.

Atlanta to Orlando. Never use this company! They are not issuing refunds during this unexpected epidemic. Families are struggling out here and may not want to travel within a year. They are not considering how they will need to have satisfied customers when this blows over. I would never fly or recommend them to anyone if this is the way you treat your customers.

header: not going to refund my money
content: Pittsburgh to Tampa Bay. My family had planned a trip to Florida to see our favorite team play in spring training then to the season opener in Tampa. Due to the pandemic and everything we had planned being post postponed or closed we are not able to go. Southwest are not going to refund my money, I have been lied to on different subjects by at least 3 different customer service reps. The last rep, who is supposed to be a senior customer service rep, pulled the act of god scenario on me. I can still use my credit till September, if this pandemic is over, but of course no one knows. So I am starting to accept the fact that I am going to lose almost $1,000. I’m just happy that Southwest is going to be ok.

Grand Rapids to Tampa. I am supposed to fly March 28th I am elderly and want to cancel. I want a refund they won’t do it because it is not there policy. Other airlines have the same policy but have changed it because of what is going on! I will personally never fly Southwest again.

header: I can’t get my money back
content: Fort Lauderdale to San Antonio. As we all know things have become a lot more difficult these past few weeks. We are living in a global crisis. But. Southwest Airlines could care less so long as they get paid. Trying to cancel a flight that was booked before everything shut down. Before the threat of disease. And I’m told I can’t get my money back? This isn’t a regular circumstance. We are dealing with a global pandemic. But again. Nobody matters more than the almighty dollar. Nothing matters more than keeping those pockets lined does it? And people wonder why nobody has any faith in American consumerism. This is why. Because the only thing that matters is money. I will never do business with your institution again. . At the end of the day, you guys can keep your measly $500. Add that to the money you’ll get when you receive your bailout money from the government. You know, the money you “need” because we’re facing a global crisis. Imagine that. Quick to receive something because of extenuating circumstances but just as quick to hold fast to their “policy” when they have to do their part. Ah yes. Corporate America has never been brighter. Two words. Never. Again.

header: feel like I have been robbed
content: Las Vegas to Chicago. Unfortunately due to the corona virus my family and I are not able to attend my brother's boot camp graduation. Southwest is not honoring the military families for not being able to make it. There shouldn't be a problem refunding the military families. I thought Southwest was promilitary but clearly they are not. This would have been my first time flying Southwest and honestly I won't ever use them again. I feel like I have been robbed. Where is the human kindness?

header: helped us get our flight bumped up
content: Fort lauderdale to Nashville. I have anxiety when flying. A wonderful woman helped us get our flight bumped up and gave me preboarding so I could bring my husband on with me and get seats together. We had just been stuck on an extended stay on a cruise ship thanks to the covid19 pandemic so I was less than thrilled to jump on a plane. Once on the plane I got some looks going on with the others that were preboarding, but I ignored it. Once we took off, I started to cry a bit because It’s just a knee-jerk reaction and I’m not good at flying. The flight attendants thought it was hilarious. Not only did they laugh then but later before landing they were talking about me as well. Needless to say, I found that rude and less than helpful. At least I’m an adult. I can’t imagine how a child would feel in that situation.

Orlando to Milwaukee. I appreciate Southwest and their customer service. 2 bags free is the ultimate feature, carry on and personal item, please don't change that, it sets you apart. The upbeat personalities are top rated! Was so easy to change flights online with no fees and easily refunded the difference.

Chicago to Dallas. Very disappointed in Southwest Airlines customer service with this virus! Other airlines are giving full refunds for nonrefundable tickets because they understand and support the severity of not spreading this virus as much as possible. It is unbelievable how stubborn and uncooperative southwest had been in this country’s time of need. You should be ashamed! We will never give southwest our business again.

header: isn't a good American corporate citizen
content: Long Island to Charleston. Because of Corvid-19, my wife and I had to rethink our trip to Myrtle Beach, especially since President Trump called it a National Emergency. I'm almost 70 and my wife is early 60's both of us are in the age group most at risk. Im told that: 1) the total cost of the flight was $421, plus an additional; $100 paid for early boarding. 2) that a credit of $221 was applied to my account 3) But I paid $521 total?. Well, the $100 you paid for the Early Boarding is not refundable! And the total amount is split between you and your wife.  I paid for the entire ticket, sorry its not done that way! SO, Southwest, isn't a good American corporate citizen capitalizing on a time of National crisis at the expense of their very customers! In the end these guys are keeping my $521 total to smooth out their downturn in travelers while the Bill is being passed to the Senate to help them out with Tax dollars which Im sure they'll also take advantage of! I can't see these Credits for the tickets and after a year I lose them! Any other time I can understand the cancelation policies, but during a National Emergency?

header: early bird check in is a scam
content: Milwaukee to Seattle. We had to cancel and rebook our up coming flight due to the corona virus. We were able to rebook the flight for a future date but they refuse to transfer the early bird check in to the new flight. We paid for a service they never provided and now they will not honor the $200.00 we paid for this service. To be clear we didn't even want a refund just transfer the service to the new flight. This is sad as Southwest used to be my favorite airline. I would strongly recommend not spending the money on early bird check in, it is a scam.

Horrible Customer Service. My husband and I went to Jamaica out of Tampa. Upon our return flight our flight was delayed for over 8 hours. We were given vouchers for food at the airport, flight credit and a hotel stay. We were told they will provide transportation to the hotel since we were getting back late. Long story short there were over 100 people waiting for transportation and they only sent 1 van for a total of 12 passengers. Southwest left us stranded at the hotel, we filed a complaint, was told wrong department and never got a follow up. This company just takes your money, gives false information and points the finger at everyone else and don't care about their customers. I would not recommend them to anyone.

Tulsa to Las Vegas. Due the current Coronavirus pandemic and state of emergency, Southwest is not refunding money or extending their cancellation policy. My Upcoming business conference has been canceled due to the Coronavirus pandemic and due to circumstances beyond my control, and I need to cancel my flight.

header: not make any exception to help us
content: On 12th March I called Southwest to change our flight from March to July, due to Walt Disney world Closing. The customer service agent was rude and would not make any exception to help us,  in a form of credit with them for the new July date, due to them having a deadline for May. We lost $250.00 T

header: avoid this airline in the future
content: Austin to Oakland via Los Angeles. 1.5 hour wait between flights turned into 4.5 hours and my boarding pass changed from A13 to B54! Supervisor had nothing to offer. No honor with this airline. Horrible service. Feeling like a hostage to this airline’s whims and they will just do as they please because you have no options. Will avoid this airline in the future. If you must fly with them I would suggest non-stop only. And good luck if they honor that!

Washington to Columbus. I've consistently had an excellent experience with Southwest Airlines, having flown them dozens of times over two decades. I live in the DC area and appreciate the number of nonstop routes from the area. While their fares are no longer the least expensive, their customer service is light years ahead of competing US-based airlines. If you have an extenuating circumstance outside of their policy, they provide more sympathy and do their best to offer solutions. They allow maximum flexibility by allowing you to keep what you paid for a flight even if your plans change up to the time of your flight. An added bonus is the free checked bags, drink coupons they provide to frequent flyers on a periodic basis, and the free on-board entertainment through Southwest Wifi.

Minneapolis to Cincinnati via Chicago. Very poorly trained customer service representatives. Was told different policies by various reps regarding military travel. Customer relations rep put me on hold multiple times to look into issue and then came back and contradicted herself twice. Bottom line I’m out $200 for travel paid to Southwest I was told I’d be able to use at a later date.

header: lose your money if you have to cancel
content: Please be cautious when you are purchasing Wanna Get Away airline tickets right now. I had purchased two tickets for some friends to come visit me in Philadelphia on my Southwest Credit Card. We were planning on going to New York; however, due to the coronavirus, they are afraid to come now and rightfully so. I purchased the tickets under my name and I was told by Southwest Airlines that I am not able to transfer those tickets to my name with no exception, so I am losing $976.92 because this was their only opportunity to come visit me and they cannot come at a later date. These tickets are non refundable and non transferrable so be aware. With everything that is going on right now, it is probably best not to purchase these tickets right now. You will lose your money if you have to cancel.

header: ask Southwest about any hidden fees
content: Nashville to Ft. Lauderdale. I had to buy a seat for my service dog the other day at the counter While checking in. Even though they knew he was traveling with me. I even called two days prior to make sure everything was still ok and they mentioned nothing... so $239 later he got on the plane and laid at my feet. Then another couple asked if they could sit with us and I said yes. Southwest said that the seat could not be refunded even though he didn’t take up a seat nor have I ever had to pay before with another airline... even though the federal law states the “airlines May not charge pst fees or other relevant charges” So if you are traveling with your Service animal you might want to ask Southwest about any hidden fees.

Kudos to Southwest! My flight got rerouted due to Heavy Fog in Atlanta So went to Birmingham AL to refuel and one of the Pilots opened a window and then couldn’t get it closed. Long story short I should have been in Phoenix by noon missed my connection had to go back to Orlando to get flight home to Phoenix! They gave us all a voucher and food voucher everyone was so extremely nice!! My day should have been 7 hours ended up 20 hours. My bag made it to Phx by the time I arrived. Outstanding work by all. Called into southwest this morning and talked to Vasa one of the consultants she’s Amazing too. I will be flying Southwest again soon.

Dallas to St. Louis. St. Louis baggage handling office thinks it funny and laugh about my luggage being soak and wet. Staff was of no help and certainly not the normal southwest employee. Bad attitude and does care about concern. There is no way my luggage should have gotten this wet. Other than dropping my luggage on the ground there is no excuse for this. I watch you baggage handler mishandle bags all the time and this time it was mine.

St. Louis to Austin. The young lady that checked us in was very rude and nasty because when she first called row A and active duty military, we approached her presented ticket and military ID she said "Oh we no longer take active duty military without uniform". We stated that's not how you called it that's why where standing here, she said the policy just changed, so I went ahead and looked this up and it states "Southwest gives special consideration to active duty military personnel. Any active-duty military passenger will be able to board after the A group regardless of their assigned boarding position."

Detroit to Puerto Vallarta via Denver. On our flight to Puerto Vallarta our group of six was divided into different groups and we were told it was because we checked I'm later than others. Checked in exactly 24 hours in advance on our return flight. there were six travelers, all were shown to be in group A, But when we got to the airport we were separated, 5 in group b I was in group C. Our connecting flight 5 were in group A, I was in group C, when asked why the women said it was because of when we checked in. We even set an alarm while on vacation so we could all check in together to avoid being split up like on our previous flights. We asked if I could board with my husband and the attendant told us to it was not allowed and to file a complaint with the company. This is the first and last time I fly with Southwest Airlines. We were treated very rudely and were dismissed by the staff. I will tell all of my friends an post our experience on social media. I would rather pay a little more to be assured I am sitting with my husband.

Las Vegas  to Atlanta. This was the best flight, they was all so helpful and had amazing customer service. I would highly recommend southwest over any of the other flights I had been on . This crew works great together and it shows.

Our International flight arrived late into Baltimore. I ran from customs in E concourse to re-check my bag at A concourse to head home to Jacksonville. By the time I got there to check my bag the flight was already boarding. There was confusion as to whether or not I had to re-check my bag with the International or Domestic counter. They could tell I was getting upset and jut wanted to get home. The woman late checked my bag and told me there was no guarantee it would make it on my flight that night. When I landed in Jacksonville my bags were there. The Southwest team had unknowingly made the end of my trip a good one. They hustled you ensure my bags would be on my flight home. Thank you Southwest!

Baltimore to Boston. Purchased a drink on flight. Should never have served the drink because they only gave us 5 minutes to drink it! Was told the receipt would be available online. It was not available on 2/12. Tried again today: entered confirmation code and flight dates and no receipt was found! Waited 20 minutes for a call back from SW (promised less than 15). First tier told me nothing could be done until Monday morning. Asked to speak to a manager. She said she could look it up on southwest.com. Why didn't the first tier offer that? She is still looking while I type this review.

Atlanta to Denver. First time flying southwest (and last). Got to Atlanta airport about one hour early. Got checked in, bags checked, and then the slowest TSA line ever. Anyway Southwest has a policy of giving up tickets if you are not at the gate ten minutes before flight. We arrived at the gate nine minutes before the flight. Our seats were given away to the already over sold flight. Now our family of four is having a day at the Atlanta airport.

I've been sitting on the plane for the past 2 hours. And that is following 3 hours of delays in the terminal. They are too heavy. This is ridiculous! Horrible management! They are removing luggage but OMG! SWA is becoming worse than the rest! Most US carriers suck, but, come on!

Kansas City to Chicago. Horrible customer service and terrible communication. Everyone between Kansa City and Chicago who work for that airlines seemed irritated that we dare bother them while flying their airline.

Las Vegas to Nashville. Never get Early Bird Check-in! It’s a scam. Bought this for $25 to “get a better boarding position and automatic check-in” 36 hours before the flight but only got B28. Really?!? Which means 88 other people also got this and I did not really get a “better boarding position” for my $25. Even spoke with Felicia the supervisor who tried to defend this deceitful practice and said she couldn’t refund or do anything about it. I travel every week for work and from now on Delta will be my choice airline.

Ontario to Seattle. As always, a great experience. This is truly the "People's" airline in that they treat you like a human being and don't purely operate to extract every last bit of profit at the expense of the passenger. I love that there's no first class, as an average seat is as good as business class on other airlines (minus food - but who relies on airline food these days anyway). Also fantastic is their no-hassle change policy. For my most recent flight, I had to change it twice. No fees, no problems. Also, two free bags checked; what's not to like!

Dallas to Little Rock. I looked forward to flying with Southwest as I have never been on any of their flights before. They do not fly up to the Greatland so no chance to do so. I waited about 4 hours for my flight after arriving from Portland. I wandered around the airport, grabbed a doughnut and coffee at Dunkins and chilled with a new book. An hour prior to departing I got my ticket, dropped of by bag and was quite impressed with the employees attitudes. What I was not impressed with was the very overcrowded gate area. I had never seen how Southwest loaded their aircraft before. It seemed to be kind of crazy at first but it worked out fine. The pilot came out and thanked us for choosing to go with him to Detroit. He was then reminded to get us to LIT and he said with a laugh that he would try. I was fortunate enough to sit by one of their pilots who was deadheading home. We chatted most of the way. The flight attendants did a great job getting drinks and chips out to those who wanted them .. short flight, up and down in 42 minutes. Bottom line, great service, fast flight and good humor ... all in all, very nicely done!

San Jose to Burbank. They canceled our flight after check-in at the airport. They have my email and cell#, and nothing, no notification. We only noticed because the boarding was late 5min. Rebooked on another flight, but now late to get home, and lousy boarding position. Agent at the gate just shrugs their shoulders. Terrible customer service. They don't even care. They are calloused to customers' complaining about their terrible service.

Denver to Houston. Our flight was delayed, by 2 hours, and their only explanation was "it was an upper management decision". After finally boarding our flight, we sat at our terminal, boarded, for another hour before setting off. There was absolutely no explanation. Never flying Southwest again.

Tampa to San Jose via Ft Lauderdale. Awful and unconfortable experience. Disgusting flight with a fly flying around us all the time. The open seating policy, is very disappointed, the attendant is not able to help you if you want to seat near a family therefore you have to pay $40 for each seat for each flight. Please keep in mind that when you buy your ticket this will increase the amount of it therefore your luggage never will be "free". Nothing is free when you flight with Southwest. My worst experience flying. Avoid this airline.

Tampa to Havana. I had very bad experience today with the crew at the check in point counter because they have a wrong information, i almost lost my flight because they were saying that i can not have a child bicycle in my luggage when a call the airline several times asking and they said yes and also every time that i fly i ask in the checking counter and they let me know as long as fix in your luggage is fine so i think they need a better training before they make decisions that they don't really know i was thinking in never fly again in this airline because this bad experience.

I had the worst experience ever with South West airlines Houston. I waited at baggage claim for over 30 minutes for my bag which never came while over the speaker the announcer called for the owner of a crown royal bag. As you may know Crown Royal is a liquor that comes in a purple and gold bag but this couldn’t be my bag even though it was purple and gold it clearly said Betsy Johnson all over it. I guess that was a funny joke for the employees to yell on the loud speaker that owner of a crown royal bag needed to come to the service desk. After realizing my bag was not coming I was directed to a room in the back where I inquired about the location of the bag. The airport staff then said oh you’re the owner of the Crown Royal bag and began to giggle. They informed that my bag fell and was ran over and some of my stuff have been destroyed with not even the smallest hint of remorse. My bag was literally destroyed to the point all the clothes and shoes In it were ripped to shreds / destroyed. When I became angry the south west employee asked me “what are you so mad about it’s not like we are not going to cut you a check”. I explained to the worker that I am in a city I have never been to with absolutely nothing to wear and all my belongings destroyed. The employee began to tell me how southwest is a million dollar company & they have no problem cutting a check as if this was suppose to make me feel better. The employee then told me it happens all the time due to southwest handling so much luggage on a daily basis and they just cut a check. The employees asked me to go through my bag and damages and asked me to price the cost of each item. The south west employee sat on the computer googled my items one by one while making comments like “ woah you really paid $200 for that ?” and arguing with me over the amount I paid for each item saying things like “ well they have it for cheaper at this store”. The worker also went as far to turn to his employee and say “ I don’t even argue with these people” After the employee calculated what he felt I deserved for my belongings he wrote a check for $620 and told me I should just go to the mall & buy new items. The employee told me I can go to chase bank and cash the check the same day which was a lie. I went to chase bank and they told me they could not cash check because southwest had to verify it and no one answered the phone. I was not able to cash check until I returned home from my vacation. The customer service was absolutely terrible and this was a major I’m convenience and embarrassing experience. I do not recommend Southwest Airlines to any one.

Omaha to Chicago via Orlando. My sister and I got separated from our group on a flight and with each group of us having an hour to two hour delays on our first flight our connecting flight where we were suppose to meet would have separate us again. Deborah was more than helpful in switching our flights for both parties. She was so kind, accommodating, and super happy during a rather frustrating time. Deborah's attitude was the only highlight of a very frustrating travel experience. The rest of the staff were short and less than helpful or pleasant. That flight that we then got switched to, thanks to Deborah, then had another two hour delay.

New York to New Orleans via Houston. This flight has been such a pain for me, my mother, and my 9 year old sister. We are on our way to a cheer competition for my sister and have had our fight delayed almost an hour and a half on the fault of the employees not checking IDs correctly. My sister is very upset and is afraid we will miss our connecting flight from Houston to New Orleans and miss her competition together. This has been an awful experience for my sisters first time flying. Thank you Southwest Airlines for a stressful and painful flying experience for me and the rest of my family.

header: totally worth the price I paid
content: Berrien Springs to San Jose. Great airline. Southwest was the best flying experience for me. The flight attendants were very nice and when I asked for a drink, they kept offering more until I was good to go. Since I was on a morning flight they offered coffee without anyone having to ask. But I do have a complaint. On my flight back home, I kept getting disconnected from their wifi for some reason. And others around me had a solid connection. If Southwest can look into this problem I will give entertainment a better review. But other than that, totally worth the price I paid.

Nashville to Denver. Staff did an excellent job keeping the trip light, and fun. They were happy to help accommodate the needs of many travelers and were professional in their work. 10/10 review, way to go y'all!
Denver to Washington. Great airline, their flight attendants were friendly, service was fast, beautiful airplane, clean, and not run down. Great disability service.

Las Vegas to Milwaukee. First time trying the on-board 'live TV' and 'wifi' service. Live TV Service was miserable - unable to use it at all. Service either wouldn't start, or when it did, would only play a couple of seconds and then quit. Tried the wifi instead, and while I was able to read a couple of E-Mails, the service was too slow to be useful for anything else. I was very disappointed.

San Jose to Denver. Customer service was terrible. I always get to stand in family boarding line with my two kids since I’m flying alone with my kids. My kids are ages 13 and 7. The lady at the door made me get out of line with my kids and did not allow me to get on the plane with family boarding. I’ve never encountered this problem before and I did not appreciate her separating us. We had to sit away from one another and my daughter cried in the plane the whole flight. I hope that makes the damn door lady happy. She must not have kids. Very unsatisfying customer service today.

Las Vegas to Austin. Warning to Active Duty Military! Their boarding policy regarding us is you must be in uniform. However they are  wish washy when it comes to this policy. Some flights I get on after A group it’s the family boarding and some I’m turned away. Even with my Military ID.

header: can't pick up my minor from the gate
content: It would have been nice to know that I actually can't pick up my minor from the gate as promised by Southwest Airlines. After everything closes at Will Roger's you cant go any further then the ticketing area. I specifically called Southwest and asked if I pick her up from the gate and they said yes. They said nothing about if TSA is closing you have to wait outside. This is the first time my little girl has flown alone and I gave her specific Instructions to wait for me at the gate not the front of the airport. A little disappointed that this was not mentioned. I was not the only mom waiting for their minor that was upset by this. I know we all looked through the instructions on how to fly a minor , but when I call to ask a specific question to the airline to make sure I didnt miss anything, nothing was mentioned about TSA closing and possibly not being able to pick up minors from the gate.

Houston to Denver via Dallas. I've even had better luck flying on United, and that's saying a lot considering United's abysmal reputation! To begin with my stories - Most recent flight, October 2019, Denver back to Houston: Unremarkable flight. Southwest check-in agent in Denver who collected my checked baggage was "mechanically" professional but lacked much in the way of personality. Upon arrival at Houston, baggage was oh, so slow to come out! Second most recent flight, October 2019, Houston via Dallas to Denver: Southwest check-in agent in Houston who collected my checked baggage was "mechanically" professional, again. Gate agents in both Houston and Dallas acted quite bored, honestly. I didn't notice the splotches of dried drink, food chunks and blood (yes, that is correct, blood) surrounding my seat until I sat down, and I had to sit down because I was one of the last people to board the plane. I sent Southwest a scathing review of that flight and got a $75 credit for a future flight for what it's worth. Third most recent flight, May 2019, Austin to Albuquerque then back to Austin: Any Southwest staff I interacted with at either airport couldn't be paid enough, it seems, to even bother to pleasantly interact with staff. That said, I remember the pilot on the first leg, from Austin to Albuquerque, trying to engage the passengers, so good for him! Fourth most recent flight, October 2018, Dallas to Louisville: The man who checked in my baggage at the curb barely said a word or even grunted, and even fairly forcefully threw said baggage onto the carousel even after I had told him that I have fragile items within! No "thank you," no "this is your ticket and go this way to your gate," nothing! Southwest's overall concept of customer service has plummeted over the last decade, and, after October 2019, I'll absolutely no longer fly them unless they are significantly cheaper than any competitor.

St. Louis to Seattle. Our flight was delayed by two hours but as I sat in the waiting gate I witnessed some of the most genuine employees of Southwest. I was sitting in gate E24 near the “help desk” and couldn’t help but overhear the employees talking. Anytime an employee walked by or came up to the help desk they were greeted with a big smile and a hug. They asked everyone how their holiday was, how their family was and just how that person was doing. It was so nice and sincere and you could tell they really cared and everyone got along well. Not only were they kind to each other they were also so kind to every single customer they had even people who were frustrated and not so nice. Usually, employees gather around and talk bad about the really annoying customers but none of them ever did. Everyone seemed to be in a really good mood and it was really nice to see such good, happy employees.

I want to point out how amazing their staff did with all of the 1st communication. 2nd and how much i had faith in them. On December 28th I was supposed to fly out of Denver into Dallas then onto Amarillo, and at that time Denver had just gotten some snow and cold weather, and the first thing they addressed was that I might not be able to get on my second flight to Amarillo because the time frame was to small, being that they would like more than an hour between, I had about 45 minutes in between, and the time just kept getting shorter and shorter. So we rebooked my flight for January 1st -  on January 1st, I was about 20 minutes away from missing my flight, maybe less, but I was aware that they said my luggage may or may not be there when I get to my final destination, in Amarillo, because of how short of time there was. But now that my flight is over I do indeed have all of my luggage, I would just like to applaud Denver International airport with the highest standards forbeing so communicative. Thank you for everything that y’all have done on my little journey!

Detroit to Phoenix. Had the most wonderful experience on my flight home today, with today being a holiday and an early Flight I was not looking forward to traveling especially with a sleepy and grumpy toddler but the flight attendant James made a dreaded experience into a relaxing, stress free and comical adventure. He was upbeat, kind and friendly and engaging with my little one and his humor aboard the flight made me laugh and feel at ease. It’s the little things that makes the difference and he nailed it. The icing on the cake he said goodbye to my daughter and still chatted with her and he got Lucky and she blew him a kiss. Anyone who crosses paths with him is indeed lucky, you will not be disappointed.

Phoenix to Los Angeles. I had the worse experience with Southwest on Dec 17. Flight was delayed for mechanical issues and I have a disability that requires medication to be taken timely. I checked my meds under the plane since this was the simplest route LAX to PHX. I let the customer service know my meds went to be put under plane they were rude and extremely rude. Told me my meds were at baggage to retrieve and got down there on my scooter and it wasn’t there nor did they even know anything about me getting my meds. Had to go back through security. Sent in a complaint on 12/17/19 someone was supposed to call me within 48 hrs never did. Called them several times and all they say is a special team is working on it. Here it is 12/31/19 and no one not anyone from Southwest has called me. Just sad, disappointed and upset at this.

header: did her best to make sure we'd make our flight
content: Oakland to Denver. Southwest's Oakland desk agents are fantastic, and provided the best experience I've had with an airline. I brought my cat in a carry on that was too big. The agent checking me in tried her best to let me by, but it clearly wouldn't fit. So she quickly snuck in the back and gave me a free Southwest pet carrier. She could have easily followed strict protocol and ruined my and others holiday, but did her best to make sure we'd make our flight. That level of service has made Southwest my number 1 airline.

header: Southwest does not care at all
content: Southwest really “flew the extra mile” today in terms of demonstrating just how terrible they are at customer service. After a 1.5 hr delay in leaving the West Coast, they informed passengers that they had informed the connecting flights to wait a bit so that passengers could make their connections. We land in the Midwest and I rush to my connection, only to find out that 1) No one had bothered to inform this flight crew that there were delayed passengers rushing to catch this flight; 2) my plane was literally sitting right there, on the other side of the glass, and they refused to let me on because they had already counted the passengers; 3) the next connection was 3.5 hours later - but oh wait that was delayed another 1.5 hrs too. So even though the two flights that I needed to catch were more than 1.5 hours delayed, they couldn’t hold this one for a few minutes. And then, when they gave me a ticket for the last flight of the day, they put me on one of the last groups for seating, and because Southwest doesn’t assign seats then it just means you will have a horrible seat. I pressed and they gave me seating after the first group. Fast forward four hours later on a late Sunday evening after traveling all day, and it looks like a small group of passengers DID get to board before everyone because they were from a connecting flight. So apparently, Southwest does not care at all if it’s one or a few persons being royally screwed by every one of their actions. All the while, the staff who answered my questions responded curtly, seemed annoyed, and one manager simply stared at me and asked what I wanted in deadpan voice after the person at the desk explained the situation. A friendly service reminder to never, ever fly this airline that doesn’t care the least bit for individual customer experiences.

header: customer service lady was extremely rude
content: I will never fly with Southwest Airlines again. Our trip was flat out cancelled in March when all of the 737 debacle happened. Not their fault. They kindly gave us an $800 flight credit to use in the next year. We saved it so that we could go and see family over the holidays. I booked it 6 weeks ago, so I could get the times I wanted. Got 2 text messages this morning delaying the flight to Dallas so that we missed our connection to Amarillo. Had to re-book and now we lost a day of time with my family. We had to get a hotel room in Amarillo because we are getting in so late and had to delay our car rental. The customer service lady was extremely rude and really couldn't care less. Oh and to add to it - I refreshed the flight information on the Southwest website. The flight time was changed back to a good time where we could have made the connection, but by the time I called they had already sold all of the seats. I guess we should have risked it and just gone to the airport hoping that something would work out. Southwest offered nothing, not even an apology for the missed time and extra money we had to spend.

Las Vegas to Rochester via Baltimore. On these two flights, I noticed that the flight attendants were less comedic than on previous Southwest flights. However, they were also kind and accommodating. During the Las Vegas flight, many of us fell asleep shortly after takeoff, and the flight attendants were very much willing to serve us beverages and snacks later on when we requested them. When I ordered a lemon-lime sparkling water with no ice, the flight attendant who served it to me added in a lime wedge and a famous Southwest "heart stirrer." Nice touch! Otherwise, things were the same as during previous flights: the underwhelming shortbread cookies and Fritos for the long flight and the pretzels for the short flight, and inflight entertainment only accessible via personal electronic devices. The flight also arrived approximately on time. All in all a good experience.

header: where you need to go on time
content: Rochester to Providence via Baltimore. These two flights took place amidst the winter storm which struck the Northeast in early December of 2019. As usual, for these short flights, we were offered beverages and pretzels. The gate agents for both flights were excellent and got us boarded quickly, but the issue was that we were delayed for both flights due to de-icing and such. The flight attendants did a good job of balancing the occasional need for speed with the need for passenger respect. Not a whole lot of joking around during these flights, too, but given the circumstances, I suppose that should not be surprising. We arrived at each location about 30 to 45 minutes late. All things considered, I think that was quite impressive! After flying with Southwest for nine flights over the span of about a week and a half, I can say that one area in which they are excellent is in getting you where you need to go on time. This is one area where they really do outperform JetBlue, and to me, it matters a lot!

header: my biggest gripe is the food
content: Rochester to Las Vegas via Baltimore and Salt Lake City. The flight from Rochester to Baltimore was operated on a Boeing 737-700, while the flight from Baltimore to Salt Lake City (and onward to Las Vegas) was operated on a Boeing 737-800. We had some comedians as flight attendants on these flights! The first two kind of struggled to get us to laugh. The third, however was absolutely hilarious! I noticed several indirect advertisements for Southwest's new flights to Hawaii through joking we had just landed in Hawaii. The flight from Rochester to Baltimore featured the usual beverage service and packet of pretzels, as did the flight from Salt Lake City to Las Vegas. For the flight from Baltimore to Salt Lake City (which was much longer), there were two beverage services, and we were offered shortbread cookies or Fritos, or both. As usual, inflight entertainment was available, but only if you had a streaming device with you. I don't know why, but for some reason, I felt like the flight attendants on the first two of these flights were a little less friendly than I've experienced in the past on Southwest. Not hostile, but just kind of passive-yet also a little impatient with passengers as they boarded (like during previous flights). I guess my biggest gripe is the food. I know it's a low-cost carrier, and I know it's a domestic flight in the U.S. But somehow, for a flight that lasts for something like five hours, I feel like people really ought to be offered more than just a couple of packets of snacks. (Yes, I am absolutely spoiled by Asian carriers, which offer full hot meals on such flights!)

Providence to Rochester via Baltimore. Two quick flights, and pretty much without incident. I was accompanying my parents, and one of them (my Dad) needed special assistance. For some reason, the gate agent in Providence said only one person was allowed to accompany my Dad during preboarding. My Mom opted to do so. The gate agent in Baltimore, however, said both my Mom and I could accompany my Dad during preboarding. During the flights, complimentary beverages were offered, as were packets of pretzels. Apparently wi-fi is available, as well as a few movies if you brought your tablet or smartphone or whatever to watch them on. The flight attendants were generally pleasant, but seemed a little bit impatient at times. I recognize that these were short flights and that they had schedules to keep (which they did indeed keep, to their credit), but it seemed like people generally were not going particularly slowly as it was, despite Southwest's unique boarding technique of having people choose their own seats. Overall, though, pretty good, and it certainly beats flying American or United!

Ontario to Denver. Take their no show policy seriously. Ten hours travel, my elderly mother appeared to have a stroke and was transported to a local emergency room. Numerous tests were being done because of the concern for her wellbeing, and the doctor was less than sure about what the cause was. Being an only child, I stayed with my mom during this process, getting her to agree to treatment, explaining what the doctors were telling her, and trying to keep her calm. The furthest thing from my mind was our planned travel to go to her college friends funeral in Colorado. While they were doing a procedure, I got the email that we missed the flight - that is how fast time flied. I immediately called, and they said it was too late, but that I should contact the corporate consumer line. Much later that day, when I left the hospital, I immediately went to the airport, and they also recommended that I contact the corporate consumer line. The staff member at the airport was understanding and encouraged me to reach out because the company is known to make exceptions. So I did. In response was an automatic, non-empathetic, “you didn’t meet our rules email”. It was clear the author never read anything I wrote, that the author never came close to the sympathy advanced by phone representative or airport representative. That the author utilized the cut and paste function to get through its tasks. The moral of the review - keep the southwest number on your favorites if you are traveling. That you have a sick family member in the emergency room is not a reason to miss the deadline or not call them to cancel. That their mission statement claiming “dedication to the highest quality of Customer Service delivered with a sense of warmth, friendliness” are words on a website, not words that consider any tragedy that may befall you or your family, unless they can advertise it for their advantage. My mom and I are nobodies to a big institution like this, so be careful, you will be too.

I have been fairly disappointed with Southwest in the last several months. I routinely fly multiple times a month between Sacramento and Los Angeles (Burbank) for work. My last 4 flights in a row, starting mid-November, have been delayed by an hour or more. And today it has already been delayed 40 minutes. It has begun to really interrupt my ability to make dependable plans. I have been a rewards member for a year, and I am looking to stop using southwest for all flights. For many months there was not a problem at all. But the last 2 months have been delay after delay. Very unfortunate they can not maintain the schedules flight times. I will begin to look to other companies for better reliability.

San Jose to Boise. I am really disappointed about how Southwest handles transfer of miles to friends and family. I just gifted my adult son 10,000 miles and it cost me $100.00 to do so! I wanted him to have the freedom to use them as he wished. I decided to go ahead and pay but next time it would seem better for me to purchase his ticket and use my miles. I have never gifted miles before so maybe it's standard practice. Regardless I know I won't be doing that again. Not worth it! In general I use Southwest and enjoy the benefits of free luggage and refundable tickets.

St Louis to Fort Lauderdale. I do believe southwest just set a company record. A three owner flight has now turned into a 18 hour nightmare. Since we left St. Louis we have had eight delays. We are going to miss our family cruise. Sitting in a plane waiting for their next delay. To make matters worse we tried to get off and drive to port. Now Southwest Airlines employees are telling us they don’t know what plane our luggage is on. Still stuck in a nightmare!

Today our 3 pm flight was cancelled for no apparent reason. Luckily we were able to book a 2 pm flight. We arrived at the airport with an hour to spare to find the southwest computers had been down for 13 hours. We had to wait in a line for 3.5 hours that wrapped three times around the inside of the airport as every single passenger had to be checked in manually. Then were put on standby for a different connecting flight which we were able to obtain seats. Unfortunately that plane was 90 minutes delayed, causing us to miss our connecting flight by 2 minutes. The connecting flight departed 10 minutes early as we watched it take flight. There are no flights home for us tonight after we just missed the last one. Meanwhile we are offered a $100 travel voucher which won’t even cover a hotel tonight. Now we have been waiting over an hour to speak to a supervisor.

Omaha to Manchester. Johnny Lopez helped us twice for this trip. Our flight from Omaha to Chicago was delayed to the point where we would miss our connecting flight. We stood in line with lots of other folks to get rescheduled for the next day and when it was our turn, Johnny was friendly and efficient and wished us a Happy Holidays. The next evening when we came back, he was working at the ticket desk and remembered us, helped us out and again wished us a Happy Holiday. Everyone, even the woman in the luggage area apologized profusely for the inconvenience. SWA is my preferred carrier and that’s the reason why

St Louis to Atlanta. Great prices and good at having available flights. My only issue is they lag everything I fly. Always delayed flights, Today I waited 20 mins at the boarding line for them to board us. I also waited 40 mins for my bags to come to baggage claim. I got places to go.

I took a beautiful trip to Jamaica- with no help from Southwest Airlines! They cancelled, then delayed, then cancelled, then delayed our original flight from Buffalo to Baltimore. They did schedule us for another flight to get to Jamaica, but leaving the next day! I work and don't just have vacation time to throw around because you delay my flight at 9 am and then can't do anything until the next day- really? I went and asked to be rebooked and we made it to Florida- not Jamaica that day, causing me to miss a day of vacation. We got $400 for that, so ok, I guess that's fine. But then we had to return home. On the way home, both flights were hours delayed and then they completely busted my checked luggage. We were also not allowed to get up during basically the whole 3 hour flight to use the restroom. I feel like telling them to take their $400 flight vouchers and shove it. They can give me cash because I don't plan on flying Southwest again. If you have planes, fly them, we're not paying for a service where the business doesn't hold up their end of the bargain, and that's what happened, if we book to fly certain days and times, the o ky thing affecting that should be weather, not mechanical issues and late planes. I'm beyond frustrated as having flights messed up can really destroy your trip. Nice try, Southwest- looking very forward to a call to your customer service tomorrow if I'm home by then!

header: not be flying  this airline anymore
content: Ft Lauderdale to Orlando. Don’t usually fly Southwest but my colleague suggested since it was for a more affordable price. Do not like the way they have seating arrangements because you aren’t able to board with who you are traveling with unless the boarding agent is a pleasant person which mine was not. And also on my way to my destination I was allowed to board outside of my seating position due to the fact I am active military, but on the way back I was not because I was not in uniform. If I’m on vacation why would I have on my uniform and it also is not safe to travel in uniform. But that is just my experience. I will not be flying with this airline anymore.

San Antonio to Phoenix. I cannot count the times I am constantly delayed with Southwest, today was no exception. Poor updates, slow customer service and a wasted day due to poor planning by the airline. Disappointing and will no longer use their services.

I am very aggravated with Southwest Airlines. We were on the plane headed to our cruise in Mexico about a month ago, something went wrong with the plane (which we were understanding because things like this happen that are out of anybody’s control). Southwest customer service was not helpful in trying to figure out how to get to our next destination. They kept ignoring us and promising us multiple vouchers while we were at the airport (that we have yet to receive). We took matters into our own hands, and at this point we had to figure out another way to get to Mexico through a different airline. Southwest promised us a refund, & vouchers (probably hoping to keep our mouth shut) but it’s been a month now & we haven’t received a single thing from them. Altogether my friends and I spent $5,000 or more that weekend because of Southwest and they can’t even give us a $75 refund for our flight. Never flying through Southwest Airlines again.

header: if you have to fly prepare for the worst
content: I had probably the worst experience with Southwest. Here is what happened: On December 1, 2019, I was flying from Baltimore to Las Vegas. By the time I got onto the plane, all the compartments are full. Then the flight attendant took my luggage and seated me in one of the front seats. After all the passengers moved out, I started looking for my bag but couldn’t find it anywhere. Then I asked for the flight attended where she put my luggage, she wasn’t able to find it either. Long story short, after calling Southwest customer service representatives, I was finally offered a $75 voucher for my lost luggage which they call it ‘for apologies’. I can’t imagine $75 dollars for my lost carry-on bag. I don’t recommend anyone to fly Southwest, if you have to fly prepare for the worst.

San Diego to Phoenix. First flight was delayed over 30 minutes. Plane flying in was late. A day later returning home was seated promptly but plane was delayed over an hour. Not a great first impression of Southwest Airlines.

In mid September, my husband and I took a short flight from Oakland to Portland, as we were moving up to our new place in Portland. I packed my wedding flatware, which I use for special occasions in my check in luggage, thinking that if I added it to my carry on, they could consider it to be dangerous. Up to this point, the other issue I had with Southwest over luggage was a few years ago when they smashed up my Samsonite luggage from OAK to Long Beach. They did correct the situation by reimbursing me for the damage. However, when I arrived at PDX and our new place, I did not unpack all of my luggage immediately, since we had 4 bags between the two of us. A few days after we landed, I looked for my flatware and found it was missing, except for the butter knives. Someone took out the 12 dinner forks, 12 salad forks, 12 Soup spoons and 12 teaspoons, I called Southwest right away and was told that they would process the claim. When I called customer service, I begged and pleaded for them to find it and return it to me. I don't even want the money for the flatware, I just wanted the flatware because it was sentimental to me. SouthWest said someone could have taken it out of my luggage and not returned it to its place and that many times it ends up at a lost and found in Atlanta. Well, I put in a claim, sent a letter and asked them to check in Atlanta. ALL I wanted was my flatware. it wasn't extremely expensive, but it was Mikasa and it had been discontinued. They denied my claim and when I appealed the denial, they sent me a letter stating that they cannot reimburse everyone for what they "claim" they lost and hoped that I would not give them bad online reviews because of it.

Baltimore to Fort Lauderdale was my 1st flight in 23 years due to PTS from a white-knuckle Washington-RDU ValuJet flight, the month after the 592 disaster, that suffered engine trouble right over Raleigh that badly scared me. The attendants especially Steve and Christie (who me & my big brother in the rear saw most) lived up to their title, doling out instructions & the meager excuse for food and drinks, in a professionally caring and friendly manner. The atmosphere was convivial & untroubled by complaints or aircraft/crew problems. This airborne adventure bookending a Carnival cruise, after such a long time & many industry changes therein, was one which the crews involved truly highlighted with their skills & friendly, engaging service. rrow" finishes which can be described as a landing only charitably - & not leave passengers marinating in their buckled seats (I didn't) for long minutes waiting for the gate!

header: all happy to take care of me
content: I took this quick trip to FL to visit my sister and help out with her friendsgiving dinner. I sat in an aisle seat and a woman sat at the window seat. It was a full flight however our middle seat was vacant somehow. I started a new medication the day before and I had taken it as well as my regular pain medicine. Being it was an early flight I had not eaten breakfast. I did have water and snacks with me on the plane if I got hungry. I started to feel hot and a little faint and it intensified to almost passing out. The woman next to me who turned out to be a spectacular nice friendly woman immediately came to my assistance. She made me eat something and she was fanning me hoping that I would not pass out. I was within minutes of doing so. The stewardesses on board were also spectacular! They asked for a nurse or doctor on board and luckily for me there was a physicians assistant directly behind me. She came over to me, took care of me, checked my blood pressure, listened to my heart and made sure that I was going to be OK. After drinking some orange juice and having some snacks my blood pressure did go down and I started to feel somewhat normal again. I never did pass out thankfully and was able to enjoy the rest of my flight and the great conversation. I can’t say enough about all four of those people who immediately came to my aid no questions asked. They were all happy to take care of me.

Tampa to Las Vegas. Theres one staff working on this flight that I recommend be taught some serious customer service skills that he is clearly lacking. Also to be told that you guys are one of the fastest airlines boarding and arriving was a complete lie after being delayed to board and having to wait for a gate on arrival.

Nashville to San Diego. Southwest has stepped it up. Ease of checkin quick security lines, expedited seating, comfortable seating with wifi and movie access. Finally a couple snack. Entire travel to and from vacation a pure joy. Arrived early on both arrivals. They've done a great job throughout all levels. Thank you for a great experience.

Baltimore to San Diego. Don’t waste your money on spending $25 for Southwest Airlines Early Bird option. I bought it nearly one week ago, but it did not show up as assigned at the 24 hour point. So I checked in myself at the exact 24 hour point. I got B02 - that’s what I think. I would get checking in at 24 hours, not a week in advance. They say no, you had early check-in. OK, that sounds fishy, whatever. But you maybe get B20-B30 tops if you check-in. Save the $25.

Spokane to San Jose. I have gone on Southwest airlines since I was 3 years old and I think its a great airline because it doesn't charge for baggage, and I love the drink selection. Something bad that happened on this airline is that once I left my jacket on the plane, and the person we asked for help wasn't very nice or helpful, but I did get my jacket back.

Las Vegas to Salt Lake City. The Crew on flight 1227 was amazing.  They were very hospitable and did an excellent job at making everyone feel relaxed. The pilot also flew the plane very smoothly. I have a weak stomach, but it almost felt like I wasn’t even on a plane.

Nashville to Las Vegas. Worst airline ever, the free movies and entertainment is useless, the free WiFi is spotty at best and when I applied for paid WiFi it never worked. Seats are incredibly small and close together. I will probably never fly with SW again. I won't mind paying extra if that need be because all other airlines I flown with are so much better.

header: separated me from my wife and 3 kids
content: Baltimore to Punta Cana. Traveling with my family to Punta Cana. Staff member who was at the gate separated me from my wife and 3 kids and claimed that it is Southwest’s policy to separate parents from their kids. I couldn’t believe that my wife was going to board alone with 3 kids that are less then 3 years old. This would definitely be the very last time I fly with Southwest. This is very sad and someone needs to really fire this rude employee who has no customer service ethics and no family values.

Grand Rapids to Albuquerque. This airline sucks. No space and you can’t sit with your husband because they have no assigned seating. If you get stuck in c and they do not follow the numbers so people cut in front. Miserable flight. I am furious that I am not allowed to sit with my husband and the person next to me is half in my seat. I have never had a more unpleasant miserable flight. I highly recommend never to travel with this airline which has less seat space than most.

header: tried to give me a run-around
content: San Jose to Baltimore. Bad airline. Our flight got canceled at the last minute and no one ever called or emailed us. We are supposed to have direct flight but they switched us to 1 stop flight, extended the total flying hours, and pushed our position to bottom. Even worst, when I complained, they tried to give me a run-around, asking me to call many different departments. Terrible. Do not flight with them at all cost.

Las Vegas to Albuquerque. Worst airline ever. They provide no flexibility in regards to flight changes. They make you check your carry ons when there’s multiple open bin spaces. They have been late departing and arriving on each flight I’ve been on. The customer service reps give you insincere apologies.

header: gone down hill in my opinion
content: Orlando to Kansas City. I have flown Southwest Airlines for around 6 years now about 12 family vacations. After my terrible experience with a overcrowded plane and a rude hostess when trying to get my family seated that clearly told us to sit down. Southwest Airlines has really gone down hill in my opinion.I am no longer going to travel with my family because of this using.

header: Wish I could have gotten a refund
